--- Myth 배틀액션
--- 은하 개화 스킬 (dokkaebi) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('MythDokkaebiBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')

	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- 연출용 곡사 발사체
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.owner)

	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ShootTiming')
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Offset')

	--- 발사 넉백 정보
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashTiming')
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashSpeed')
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashDuration')

	--- 투사체 사거리
	self.max_range = 7

	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params)
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 타겟 할당 해제
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_available()
	return true
end

--- 배틀 액션이 이 캐릭터를 제어하는지 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end
--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_trigger()
	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.owner.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target, dir_vector, _ = battle_util.get_closest_target_in_active_battle(self.owner)

	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cutin')
end

function local_class:on_start(info)
	--- anim
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 발사 연출 간격 조절이 필요해서 넣음
	self.animation_info['cast'].timescale = 0.4
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset
	local target_pos = nil

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
		target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.target)
	else
		target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(shoot_pos + self.dir_vector * self.max_range)
	end

	-- 폭발
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', target_pos)
	battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'explosion', target_pos)
	--- screen fx
	battle_util.camera_shake_fadeout(self.owner, 0.25, 0.8, nil, 1)
	--- sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'start')
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then return end

	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.35) then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(self.cs_action, nil, -self.dir_vector,
			0, 0.3, self.dash_speed/5,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale / 5,
			nil, false, 0)

		--- 캐릭터 뒤로 재껴지는 발사 반동 연출
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.5, 0.1, 0.5, 15)

		self.animation_info['cast'].timescale = 1
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	end

	--- 데미지 타이밍 체크
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then break end

		local hit_targets = battle_manager_util.get_targets_in_active_battle(self.owner)

		if #hit_targets == 0 then break end

		--- 현재 전투 전체 데미지
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier, self.max_hit)

		for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
		end
	until true end



end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

    battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
end

function local_class:on_start(info)

    support_action_util.set_darken_on_declare(self.owner, self)

    --- 폭파 사운드 출력
    battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')
    --- 공격 애니메이션 출력
    battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'attack')
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
    --- 트리거 되지 않았다면
    if not self.trigger then return end

    --- 애니메이션 삭제
    battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
    --- 끝날 때 방향을 dir vector 으로 돌려줌
    character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))
    --- 방향고정 해제
    battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
    --- 암전 해제
    support_action_util.unset_darken(self, 0.5)

    --- 트리거 플래그 교체
    self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

    --- 실제 판정 처리
    if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
        --- 폭파 이펙트
        battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', character_util.get_position(self.owner))
        --- 쉐이킹
        battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.7, 0.4)

        local hit_targets = battle_manager_util.get_targets_in_active_battle(self.owner)

        if #hit_targets > 0 then
            --- 각 판정별 데미지 계수 계산
            local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier, self.max_hit)

            --- 피격 대상 순회
            for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
                self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
            end
        end
    end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
    --- 데미지 정보 생성
    local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
    damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
    damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
    damage_info.sender = self.owner
    damage_info.target = target
    damage_info.modifier = modifier
    damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

    --- 데미지 커맨드 발행
    command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
    create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
        return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
    end,
}

end

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

function local_class:on_trigger()
	local target, dir_vector, _ = battle_util.get_closest_target_in_active_battle(self.owner)

	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 타겟 랜덤 위치 계산 필요
	self.target_random_pos = {};

	--- 랜덤한 각도 먼저 계산
	local random_angle = random_util.get_random_value() * 360

	--- 내 위치 중심으로 120도를 계산해 랜덤하게 fx 위치를 정해줌
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		local angle = math.rad(random_angle)
		random_angle = random_angle + 120

		self.target_random_pos[idx] = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + (vector(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * 3.7)
	end

	--- 스파인 오프셋 세팅
	spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * self.jump_height)

	--- 스파인 알파 세팅
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 0, 0)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'declare')
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 시전 애니메이션 출력
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.4, 0.5)

	--- 스파인 페이드 처리
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.5)

	support_action_util.set_darken_on_declare(self.owner, self)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then return end

	--- 애니메이션 삭제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 끝날 때 방향을 dir vector 으로 돌려줌
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))
	--- 방향고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- 암전 해제
	support_action_util.unset_darken(self, 0.5)
	--- 스파인 오프셋 초기화
	spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.zero)
	--- 스파인 알파 초기화
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0)
	--- 스파인 회전 초기화
	spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(0)

	-- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

	--- 액션 시작부터 끝까지 점프 조지는 부분
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.2, 1) then
		--- ease graph 를 이용한 progress
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInCubic(time_passed - 0.2, 0, 1, 0.8)

		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress))
	end

	--- 캐릭터 회전 조지는 부분
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.5, 1) then
		--- ease graph 를 이용한 progress
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed - 0.5, 0, 1, 0.5)

		spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(-360 * progress, 0)
	end

	--- 판정 처리
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		--- 투사체 발사를 위한 처리
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx] - 0.15) then
			battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

			local shoot_pos = self.target_random_pos[idx] + vector(0, 7, 2)

			local shoot_dir = vector_util.normalized(self.target_random_pos[idx] - shoot_pos)

			--- 투사체 발사
			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
				self.shoot_helper[1],
				shoot_pos,
				shoot_dir,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				false,
				nil,
				self.target_random_pos[idx]
			)
		end

		--- 실제 판정 처리
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

			--- 폭파 사운드
			battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

			--- 폭파 이펙트
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.target_random_pos[idx])

			--- 쉐이킹
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.2)

			-- 대상 취합
			local hit_targets = battle_manager_util.get_targets_in_active_battle(self.owner)

			if #hit_targets > 0 then
				--- 각 판정별 데미지 계수 계산
				local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier, self.max_hit)

				--- 피격 대상 순회
				for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
					self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	--- 착지 애니메이션 출력
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.8)  then
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'landing')
	end

	--- 점프가 끝
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 1)  then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'jump', character_util.get_position(self.owner))

		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.zero)
		spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(0, 0)

		--- 착지 사운드
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'landing')
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'splash')

	self.trigger = false
end

--- 18챕터 머니샷(격투게임) 플레이어블 캐릭터의 평타 콤보 액션
local local_class = newclass('NormalHeavenholdRobotBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	self.original_action_duration = self.action_duration
	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	self.damage = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Damage')
	self.stun_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StunDuration')
	self.stun_factor = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StunFactor')
	self.knock_back_distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackDistance')
	self.knock_back_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackDuration')


	--- 액션 유형 목록
	self.action_type = {
		first = 1,
		second = 2,
		third = 3,
	}
	--- 1,2,3 타 구분자
	local attack_type_key = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	self.attack_type = self.action_type[attack_type_key]

	--- 판정 박스 캐릭터로부터 적방향 거리
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	self.hit_height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitHeight')

	local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
	self.hit_end_timing = self.hit_timing + attack_duration
	self.penalty_action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PenaltyActionDuration')

	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	self.dash_end_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashEndTiming')
	self.dash_distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDistance')
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	self.combo_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param,'ComboBuff')

	--- 판정 박스는 캐릭터 키높이와 Length값, 지속시간은 AttackDuration 만큼 잔류
	local box_height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 피격 판정의 길이
	local box_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	local size = vector(box_length, box_height, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).z)

	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, attack_duration, nil, true)
	--- 박스형 충돌 박스
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(
		self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, 1
	)

	self.magnitude = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShakeMagnitude')
	self.shake_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShakeDuration')

	self.screen_controller = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.GetOrCreateGlobalTable("minigame/RobotFight/Controller/ScreenController")

	self.hit_sfx_key = { 'hit1', 'hit2', 'hit3' }
	self.cast_sfx_key = { 'cast1', 'cast2', 'cast3' }
	self.attack_sfx_key = { 'attack1', 'attack2', 'attack3', 'attack4' }

	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 처리 함수
	self.on_spine_event_func = function(entry, event)
		self:on_spine_event(entry, event)
	end

	--- 스켈레톤 애니메이션 할당
	self.skeleton_animation = self.owner.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation

	--[[
	local action = self.action.animation_info['cast']
	local original_action_duration = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(self.owner.SpineController, action.name)
	--action.timescale = original_action_duration / original_action_duration

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.first then
		action.name = 'attack1_3'
		action.timescale = original_action_duration / 1

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.second then
		action.name = 'attack1_4'
		action.timescale = original_action_duration / 1

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.third then
		action.name = 'attack2'
		action.timescale = original_action_duration / 1.3

	end
	self.action_duration = original_action_duration
	self.action.animation_info['cast'] = action]]
end

function action_state_class:dispose()

end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded() return true end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling() return true end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable() return true end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target) return true end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.right
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 격겜이라 오른쪽만 본다.
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 공격 애니메이션
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	local custom_event = CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent.Create(
		self.owner,
		CS.Oak.MoneyShotEventType.ActionStart
	)
	message_system:Publish(custom_event)

	--- 하나도 적중 못했다면 패널티 부여
	self.any_hit = false
	self.action_duration = self.original_action_duration

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.first then
		battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, self.cast_sfx_key[random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)])

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.third then
		battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, self.cast_sfx_key[random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)])
	end

	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 할당
	self.skeleton_animation.state:Event('+', self.on_spine_event_func)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.2)
	--- end calculator
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	if self.any_hit == false then
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner,self.owner,self.combo_buff_info.name)
	end
	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 할당
	self.skeleton_animation.state:Event('-', self.on_spine_event_func)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing, self.dash_end_timing) then
		if self.dash_distance > 0 then
			local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(time_passed - self.dash_timing, 0, 1, self.dash_end_timing)
			local movement = progress
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			local dir = unity_class.vector3.right

			move_info.direction = dir
			move_info.magnitude = self.dash_distance * movement

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(dir), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.owner, move_event)
		end
	end

	--- 연출 시작 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
		--- 중심 위치
		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector

		self.screen_controller:shake(self.magnitude * 0.5, self.shake_duration * 0.75)

		--- 캐스팅 이펙트, 사운드 재생
		---self.attack_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', target_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'cast')

		--battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
	end

	--- 판정 체크
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 중심 위치
		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector

		--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, target_pos)
		--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)
		--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			self.any_hit = true
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.combo_buff_info)

			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, hit_targets[1] == target)
			end

			-- 랜덤 'hit' 사운드 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, self.hit_sfx_key[random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)])
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_end_timing) and self.any_hit == false then
		self.action_duration = self.penalty_action_duration
	end

end
--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, send_shake)
	if target == nil then return end

	target.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.damage = self.damage
	damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.EmptyHitEffect.Instance

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행 및 결과 정보 받아옴
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	target.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true

	local custom_event = CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent.Create(
		self.owner,
		CS.Oak.MoneyShotEventType.Damage,
		CS.Oak.MoneyShotAttackTag.NormalAttack,
		self.damage,
		self.stun_duration,
		self.knock_back_distance,
		self.knock_back_duration,
		self.hit_height,
		send_shake and self.magnitude or 0,
		send_shake and self.shake_duration or 0
	)
	message_system:Send(target, custom_event)
end

function action_state_class:on_spine_event(entry, event)
	--- 이벤트 키 검증
	if event.Data.Name == 'sfx2' then
		battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'sfx')

	else
		if self.attack_type == self.action_type.third then
			battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, self.attack_sfx_key[random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)])

		else
			battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, self.attack_sfx_key[random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)])
		end
	end
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)
		self.action_state:dispose()
		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, vector_util.right)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end
--endregion

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 18챕터 머니샷(격투게임) 플레이어블 캐릭터의 가드 및 패리
local local_class = newclass('ParryHeavenholdRobotBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region parry state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	self.damage = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Damage')
	self.stun_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StunDuration')
	self.stun_factor = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StunFactor')
	self.knock_back_distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackDistance')
	self.knock_back_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackDuration')

	--- 패리 판정 타이밍과 유지시간
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 판정 박스 캐릭터로부터 적방향 거리
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
	--- 반격 시 판정 박스 정보
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	self.hit_height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitHeight')

	local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
	--- 판정 박스는 캐릭터 키높이와 Length값, 지속시간은 AttackDuration 만큼 잔류
	local box_height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 피격 판정의 길이
	local box_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	local size = vector(box_length, box_height, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).z)

	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, attack_duration, nil, true)
	--- 박스형 충돌 박스
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(
		self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, 1
	)

	self.magnitude = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShakeMagnitude')
	self.shake_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShakeDuration')

	self.hit_sfx_key = { 'hit1', 'hit2', 'hit3' }

	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 처리 함수
	self.on_spine_event_func = function(entry, event)
		self:on_spine_event(entry, event)
	end
	--- 스켈레톤 애니메이션 할당
	self.skeleton_animation = self.owner.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation

	self.dir_vector = vector_util.right
end

end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 격겜이라 오른쪽만 본다.
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 공격 애니메이션
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'cast')
	local custom_event = CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent.Create(
		self.owner,
		CS.Oak.MoneyShotEventType.ActionStart
	)
	message_system:Publish(custom_event)
	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 할당
	self.skeleton_animation.state:Event('+', self.on_spine_event_func)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- end calculator
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 할당 해제
	self.skeleton_animation.state:Event('-', self.on_spine_event_func)

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
		--- 중심 위치
		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector

		--- 캐스팅 이펙트, 사운드 재생
		---self.attack_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', target_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'cast')

		---battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
	end

	--- 판정 체크
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 중심 위치
		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector

		--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, target_pos)
		--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)
		--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, hit_targets[1] == target)
			end
			-- 랜덤 'hit' 사운드 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, self.hit_sfx_key[random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)])
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 패리 끝남
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, send_shake)
	if target == nil then return end

	target.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.damage = self.damage
	damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.EmptyHitEffect.Instance

	--damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info[hit_sfx_name].sfxName)

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행 및 결과 정보 받아옴
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	target.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true

	local custom_event = CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent.Create(
		self.owner,
		CS.Oak.MoneyShotEventType.Damage,
		CS.Oak.MoneyShotAttackTag.HeavyAttack,
		self.damage,
		self.stun_duration,
		self.knock_back_distance,
		self.knock_back_duration,
		self.hit_height,
		send_shake and self.magnitude or 0,
		send_shake and self.shake_duration or 0
	)
	message_system:Send(target, custom_event)
end

function action_state_class:on_spine_event(entry, event)
	--- 이벤트 키 검증
	if event.Data.Name == 'sfx' then
		battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'sfx')
	end
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(

	)

	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)

	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	do

	return self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- @return boolean 제어 여부

	return true

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지

	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	if self:is_available() == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 정보 싱크
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 스테이트 변경
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	--- 액션이 활성화되어 있는 경우
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,

--- 협동 원정대 포지션 스킬 배틀액션
--- 힐러 긴급 회복, 일정 범위 내의 파티원의 체력을 회복시킨다
local local_class = newclass('PositionHealingWaveBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 힐량
	heal_modifier = nil,

	--- 대상 탐색 거리
	search_range = nil,

	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 회복량
	self.heal_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealModifier')
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
			self.search_range, height, nil, nil, nil, true)

	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, false, 0, 0, true)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.search_range
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(_)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 시작
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'action')
	--- camera darken
	position_skill_util.set_darken(self.cs_action, 0.1)

	local position = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	self:shoot(position)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	position_skill_util.unset_darken(self.cs_action)
	--- 이모션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:shoot(position)
	--- 판정 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, position)
	--- 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'action', position,
			vector_util.zero, self.owner.Transform)

	--- 판정 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do repeat
		-- 디버프 제거
		if battle_util.can_apply_cure(self.owner, fo ,true) then
			buff_manager:CureAllDebuffs(self.owner, fo)
		end

		-- 힐
		if battle_util.can_apply_heal(self.owner, fo, true) then
			if float_util.almost_close_to(character_util.get_hp_ratio(fo), 1) then
				break
			end

			-- heal
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.sender = self.owner
			heal_info.target = fo
			heal_info.heal = math.floor(character_util.get_recovery(self.owner) * self.heal_modifier)

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
		end
	until true end
end

	self.cs_action = cs_action

			cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do

		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
				self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end

local local_class = newclass('PositionMeleeBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위

	--- 데미지

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	collision_calculator = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 데미지 수치
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackModifier')
	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
	--- 명중 시 버프 부여
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'Buff')
	--- 보스에게도 적용시킬 것인가?
	self.is_apply_boss = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(param, 'IsAilmentBossTarget')
	--- 상태 이상 정보

	--- 모션 변경 타이밍
	self.animation_change_timing = self.action.animation_info['action'].removeAfter

	--- 시작 이펙트 타이밍
	self.start_timing = math.max(0, self.dash_timing - 0.2)

	--- 타격 가능 거리
	self.hittable_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
end

end

--- @return boolean 제어 여부

	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부

	return false
end

--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 시작 애니메이션 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 시작 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'action')

	--- camera darken
	position_skill_util.set_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- 방향 전환
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, dir)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	position_skill_util.unset_darken(self.cs_action)
	--- 이모션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	if self.dash_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.dash_fx)
		self.dash_fx = nil
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 존재하고, 방향을 갱신해야 할때
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		--- 대상, 대상 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.start_timing) then
		local owner_center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'action', owner_center, self.dir_vector)
	end

	self:thrust_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	self:hit_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:thrust_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	--- 오너의 중심
	local owner_center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 관통 대쉬
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,0, self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0
		)

		--- 찌르기 이펙트 생성
		self.dash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'thrust', owner_center, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- 흔드는 시간
		local shake_duration = (self.action_duration - self.dash_timing) * 0.8
		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, shake_duration)
		--- 캐릭터 흔들기
		character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.06, shake_duration)
	end

	--- 모션 변경 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.animation_change_timing) then
		--- 찌르기 애니메이션 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'thrust')
	end

	--- IK 세팅
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, owner_center + self.dir_vector, owner_center)
end

function action_state_class:hit_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	local dash_end = self.dash_timing + self.dash_duration
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, dash_end) then
		-- 확정 타격
		self:apply_damage()

		if self.dash_fx then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.dash_fx)
			self.dash_fx = nil
		end
	end

function action_state_class:apply_damage()
	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.2)

	-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
		damage_info.direction = self.dir_vector
		damage_info.sender = self.owner
		damage_info.target = self.target
		damage_info.modifier = self.attack_modifier
		damage_info.critical = true

		--- 상태이상 수치 추가
		if 0 < self.ailment_info.AilmentGauge then

			local is_boss = battle_manager:IsBoss(self.target)

			if is_boss and self.is_apply_boss then
				damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)

			elseif not is_boss then
				damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
			end
		end

		--- 피격(폭발) 사운드
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

		--- 피격 이펙트
		damage_info.hit_effect = damage_info_util.create_unity_object_hit_effect(
				self.action, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(self.target), self.dir_vector, parent_follow_flag.none
		)

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

		--- 버프가 있다면 적용
		if self.buff_info.name then
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.target, self.buff_info)
		end
	end
end

	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

	)

	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신

		)

		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil

end

--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	if self:is_available() == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

	position_skill_util.reset_time_passed(self.cs_action)

	self.action_state:start(info)

	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

	--- 액션이 활성화되어 있는 경우
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))

end

end

	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)

	message_system_util.unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), self.on_move_field_object_event_func)

	--- 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제

	self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	self.on_move_field_object_event_func = nil

	--- state reset
	self.machine:change(nil)
end

function shield_state_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.shield_vfo == nil then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.shield_vfo) then
		--- 파괴 이펙트
		local dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.shield_vfo.Direction)
		local position = character_util.get_position(self.shield_vfo)
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'break', position, dir_vector)

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'break')

		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function shield_state_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.shield_vfo == nil then
		return
	end

	local target = e.Info.target
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.shield_vfo)  then
		--- break면 그냥 넘김
		if character_util.get_hp(self.shield_vfo) < 1 then
			return
		end

		-- 히트 이펙트
		local dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.shield_vfo.Direction)
		local position = character_util.get_position(self.shield_vfo)
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'hit', position, dir_vector, character_util.get_transform(self.owner))
		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'hit')
	end
end

function shield_state_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	if self.shield_vfo == nil then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.owner) then
		self:update_shield_transform()

		if self.shield_vfo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
			-- 디버그용
			CS.Oak.DebugDrawerExtensions.DrawCube(bounds_util.get_size(self.shield_vfo), bounds_util.get_center(self.shield_vfo), vector_util.right)
		end
	end
end

function shield_state_class:init_shield_object()
	local has_value, fo_list = position_skill_extensions.TryGetPositionSkillEntityList(
		character_util.get_entity_id(self.owner), 'PositionProjectileShield'
	)

	if not has_value then
		return false
	end

	local vfo = fo_list[0]

	-- 오브젝트 스펙 생성
	local fo_spec = CS.Oak.FieldObjectSpec()
	fo_spec = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.SetFieldObjectSpecHpBase(fo_spec, self.shield_amount)

	-- 기본 NullFieldObjectStatsBehaviour 이기 때문에 새로 설정함.
	local stats_behaviour = CS.Oak.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour()
	stats_behaviour.FieldObjectSpec = fo_spec
	vfo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour = stats_behaviour

	vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.shield_vfo = vfo
	self.shield_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	self.shield_fx = nil

	return true
end

function shield_state_class:activate_shield(direction)
	if self.shield_vfo == nil then
		return
	end

	self.shield_vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	local dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(direction)
	local position = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + dir_vector * self.shield_offset
	self.shield_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'loop', position)

	self:update_shield_transform(direction)

	-- heal info
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = self.shield_vfo
	heal_info.heal = self.shield_amount
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	-- heal
	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

function shield_state_class:deactivate_shield()
	if self.shield_vfo == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.shield_vfo.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
		self.shield_vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

		-- 종료 이펙트
		local dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.shield_direction)
		local position = character_util.get_position(self.shield_vfo)
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'end', position, dir_vector, self.owner.Transform)

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'end')
	end

	if self.shield_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.shield_fx)
		self.shield_fx = nil
	end
	self.shield_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
end

function shield_state_class:update_shield_transform(direction)
	local dir_vector
	if direction then
		character_util.set_direction(self.shield_vfo, direction)
		self.shield_direction = direction

		dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(direction)
		local is_side = math.abs(dir_vector.x) > 0
		if is_side then
			self.shield_vfo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(self.shield_length, self.shield_height, self.shield_width))
		else
			self.shield_vfo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(self.shield_width, self.shield_height, self.shield_length))
		end
	else
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.shield_direction)
	end

	local position = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + dir_vector * self.shield_offset
	self.shield_vfo.Position = position
	effect_util.update_object(self.shield_fx, position, dir_vector)
end

--- action state enter
function shield_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 방향
	local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
	--- 쉴드 활성화
	self:activate_shield(look_dir)
end

function shield_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 쉴드 비활성화
	self:deactivate_shield()
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function shield_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shield_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 쉴드 활성화 상태
	self.shield_active_state = shield_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 쉴드 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.shield_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.shield_active_state.machine = self.shield_state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		self.shield_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.shield_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state, self.shield_active_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.shield_active_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	return position_skill_util.is_charged(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	if self:is_available() == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	local dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 쿨타임 리셋
	position_skill_util.reset_time_passed(self.cs_action)
	--- 액션 스테이트 정보 싱크
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 스테이트 변경
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.shield_state_machine:change(nil)

	--- 액션이 활성화되어 있는 경우
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	if self.shield_state_machine.state == self.shield_active_state then
		self.shield_active_state:force_cancel()
	end
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
	if self.shield_state_machine then
		self.shield_state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:enter_shield_active_state()
	if self.shield_state_machine.state ~= nil then
		self.shield_state_machine:change(nil)
	end

	self.shield_state_machine:change(self.shield_active_state)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 협동 원정대 포지션 스킬 배틀액션
--- 원딜 공격 스킬
local local_class = newclass('PositionRangedBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 데미지
	attack_modifier = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	collision_calculator = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 폭발 범위
	self.explosion_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionRadius')
	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	--- 발사 포지션 지정 타이밍
	self.targeting_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TargetingTiming')
	--- 메테오 낙하 시간
	self.fall_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FallDuration')
	--- 어그로 수치
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackModifier')
	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 타겟 없을 시 오프셋
	self.forward_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ForwardOffset')
	--- 명중 시 버프 부여
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'Buff')
	--- 보스에게도 적용시킬 것인가?
	self.is_apply_boss = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(param, 'IsAilmentBossTarget')
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, 0)

	--- 낙하 높이
	self.fall_height = 10
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	self.shoot_timing = math.max(self.shoot_timing, 0.1)

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
		self.explosion_radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)

	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)
end

function action_state_class:dispose()
	self:cancel_meteor()
	self.calculator = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.search_range
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상 포지션, 방향만 지정
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 전환
	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(
		vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner))
	)
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector)
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, dir)

	--- 애니메이션 시작
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- camera darken
	position_skill_util.set_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- cast
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		vector_util.zero, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	-- 캐스팅 ui
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.owner, self.action_duration))

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	position_skill_util.unset_darken(self.cs_action)
	--- 이모션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.owner))
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.targeting_timing) then
		local target, _ = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

		local owner_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
		local target_pos
		if target then
			target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(target))
		else
			local dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
			target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(dir) * self.forward_offset
		end

		self.target_pos = target_pos

		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - owner_pos))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, dir)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		self:shoot()

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_meteor(dt)
	if self.proj_fx == nil or self.trail_fx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.meteor_time_passed = self.meteor_time_passed + dt

	if self.meteor_time_passed < self.fall_duration then
		local progress = self.meteor_time_passed / self.fall_duration
		local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.start_pos, self.meteor_target_pos, progress)
		effect_util.update_object(self.proj_fx, move_pos)
		effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, move_pos)
	else
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_fx)
		self.proj_fx = nil
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
		self.trail_fx = nil
		self:on_meteor_hit(self.meteor_target_pos)
	end
end

function action_state_class:cancel_meteor()
	if self.proj_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_fx)
		self.proj_fx = nil
	end

	if self.trail_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
		self.trail_fx = nil
	end
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	if info.Positions.Count == 0 then
		return
	end

	self.meteor_target_pos = info:GetPositionAt(0)

	--- 투사체
	self.start_pos = self.meteor_target_pos + unity_class.vector3(0, self.fall_height, 0)
	self.proj_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'proj', self.start_pos)
	self.trail_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'trail', self.start_pos)

	self.meteor_time_passed = 0

	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, self.fall_duration)
end

function action_state_class:shoot()
	local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.owner, self.cs_action.HandleName, self.target_pos)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.owner.Owner, cmd)
end

function action_state_class:on_meteor_hit(hit_pos)
	--- explosion
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', hit_pos)

	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	--- 카메라 흔들기

--- 협동 원정대 포지션 스킬 배틀액션
--- 힐러 부활, 맵 위 모든 아군 캐릭터 부활
local local_class = newclass('PositionResurrectionBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 버프 정보
	buff_info = nil,
	--- 타겟당 쿨타임 추가
	cool_time_add = 1,

	current_time_passed = 0
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action

end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 회복량
	self.heal_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealModifier')

	self.cool_time_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CoolTimePerTarget')

	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지

	return true

--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
