end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(_)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	self:start_casting()

	--- 포지션 스킬 쿨타임 갱신 멈춤
	position_skill_util.disable_update_time_passed(self.cs_action)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	position_skill_util.unset_darken(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 이모션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	--- 포지션 스킬 쿨타임 갱신 시작
	position_skill_util.enable_update_time_passed(self.cs_action)

	if self.target_list ~= nil then
		for character, marker in pairs(self.target_list) do
			if not is_unity_null(marker) then
				-- 타겟 마커 이펙트 제거
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(marker)
			end

			self.target_list[character] = nil
		end
		self.target_list = nil
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.owner))
end

function action_state_class:start_casting()
	--- 애니메이션 시작
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'action')

	--- camera darken
	position_skill_util.set_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.09, 0.4)

	-- 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'action', character_util.get_position(self.owner), unity_class.vector3.zero,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	-- 캐스팅 ui
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.owner, self.action_duration))

	self.target_list = {}
	local model = CS.Oak.CoopClient.Instance.CoopModel
	local members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)
	for _,character in pairs(members) do repeat
		-- 관짝으로 변하기 전 죽는 연출 중에는 부활 적용 안함
		if is_unity_null(character) or not character_util.is_dead(character) or not character.IsInCoffin then
			break
		end

		if model then
			local slot_id = CS.Oak.ClientCoopExtensions.GetSlotIdByICharacter(model, character)
			if slot_id == -1 or not CS.Oak.CoopClient.Instance:IsAliveCoopPlayer(slot_id) then
				break
			end
		end

		-- 이펙트
		local marker = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action, 'marker', character_util.get_position(character), unity_class.vector3.zero,
				character_util.get_transform(character)
		)

		self.target_list[character] = marker
	until true end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.owner))

		--- 부활
		self:resurrect()

		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:resurrect()
	if self.target_list == nil then
		return
	end

	local count = 0
	for character, marker in pairs(self.target_list) do repeat
		-- 관짝으로 변하기 전 죽는 연출 중에는 부활 적용 안함
		if is_unity_null(character) or not character_util.is_dead(character) or not character.IsInCoffin then
			if not is_unity_null(marker) then
				-- 타겟 마커 이펙트 제거
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(marker)
			end

			self.target_list[character] = nil
			break
		end

		-- heal
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = self.owner
		heal_info.target = character
		heal_info.heal = math.max(1, math.floor(character_util.get_recovery(self.owner) * self.heal_modifier))
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true

		--- 부활로 인한 힐 이펙트 설정
		heal_info.healEffect = damage_info_util.create_unity_object_hit_effect(self.action, 'target', character_util.get_position(character))

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		-- 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, character, self.buff_info)

		-- 타겟 마커 이펙트 제거
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(marker)
		self.target_list[character] = nil

		count = count + 1
	until true end

	self.target_list = nil

	--- 부활 시킨 아군 수에 따라 쿨타임이 가산됨
	local cool_time = position_skill_util.get_cool_time(self.cs_action) + self.cool_time_add * count
	position_skill_util.set_cool_time(self.cs_action, cool_time, true)
end

end

function local_class:force_cancel()

--- 협동 원정대 포지션 스킬 배틀액션
--- 탱커 도발
local local_class = newclass('PositionTauntBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- 어그로 수치
	aggro_value = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	collision_calculator = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 어그로 수치
	self.aggro_value = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AggroValue')

	--- 일반몬스터 상대 어그로 지속시간
	self.normal_monster_aggro_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'NormalMonsterAggroDuration')

	--- 보스 전용 어그로 지속시간
	self.aggro_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AggroDuration')

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
			self.search_range, height, nil, nil, nil, true)

	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.search_range
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 전환
	battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

	--- 애니메이션 시작
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'action')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.09, 0.4)

	--- camera darken
	position_skill_util.set_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	self:publish_taunt()
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	position_skill_util.unset_darken(self.cs_action)
	--- 이모션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:publish_taunt()
	--- 시전자 위치
	local owner_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)

	--- 판정 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, owner_pos)

	--- 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'action', owner_pos)

	--- 판정 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, 0)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		--TODO:
		--보스 일반몬스터 구분해서 따로 넣어주면 됨
		if battle_manager and battle_manager:IsBoss(fo) then
			command_util.publish_aggro_add(self.owner, fo, self.aggro_value, self.aggro_duration)
		else
			command_util.publish_aggro_add(self.owner, fo, self.aggro_value, self.normal_monster_aggro_duration)
		end
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
			cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
				self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	return position_skill_util.is_charged(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()

--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부

function local_class:trigger()
	if self:is_available() == false then

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then

	--- 방향 정보 추가

local local_class = newclass('ProjectileAreaBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	self.area_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ProjAreaRadius', 8)
	self.projectile_amount = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ProjectileCount', 12)
	self.empty_proj_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'EmptyCount', 2)
	self.unblockable_proj_count = math.min(CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'UnblockableCount', 4), self.projectile_amount - self.empty_proj_count)
	self.projectile_initial_scale = 0.1

	self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionRadius', 3)
	self.ailment_gauge = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AilmentGauge", 0)

	self.explosion_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionDamageModifier', 5)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.5)
	self.knock_back_factor = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackFactor",
			CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong)

	local blockable_projectile_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'BlockableProjectile', 'graboid_acid_saliva_proj')
	local ps = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.character)
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(blockable_projectile_name)
	self.projectile_radius = projectile_spec_util.get_hit_box_width(spec) * 0.5
	self.projectile_speed = battle_util.get_number(spec.Speed)
	local pattern_info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_info.columns = 1
	self.blockable_shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.None, 0)

	local unblockable_projectile_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'UnblockableProjectile', 'graboid_acid_saliva_proj')
	ps = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.character)
	spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(unblockable_projectile_name)
	pattern_info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_info.columns = 1
	self.unblockable_shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.None, 0)

	local initial_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialProjAngle", 15) * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad
	local angle_per_proj = math.pi * 2 / self.projectile_amount
	self.shoot_offset_infos = {}
	for i = 0, self.projectile_amount - 1 do
		local rad = initial_angle + angle_per_proj * i
		local offset = unity_class.vector3(math.cos(rad), 0, math.sin(rad)) * self.area_radius + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.1
		local attack_range = battle_range_util.create_circle(self.projectile_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		battle_range_util.hide(attack_range)
		table.insert(self.shoot_offset_infos, {offset = offset, attack_range = attack_range})
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.shoot_type = {
		none = 1,
		blockable = 2,
		unblockable = 3
	}

	self.index_table = {}
	for i = 1, self.projectile_amount do
		self.index_table[i] = i
	end

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.character.Position)

	-- 투사체 타입 중 수가 적은 타입을 골라서 셔플
	local blockable_count = self.projectile_amount - self.empty_proj_count - self.unblockable_proj_count
	local pick_blockable = self.unblockable_proj_count > blockable_count
	local pick_count = pick_blockable and blockable_count or self.unblockable_proj_count
	pick_count = pick_count + self.empty_proj_count
	trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, pick_blockable and self.shoot_type.blockable or self.shoot_type.unblockable)

	for i = 1, pick_count do
		-- 셔플
		local j = random_util.get_random_int(i + 1, self.projectile_amount)
		self.index_table[i], self.index_table[j] = self.index_table[j], self.index_table[i]
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.index_table[i])
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:get_opposite_type(type)
	return type == self.shoot_type.blockable and self.shoot_type.unblockable or self.shoot_type.blockable
end

function local_class:start(info)
	if not trigger_info_util.contains_integer(info) then
		return
	end
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	local integers = info.Integers
	local pick_type = integers[0]
	local opposite = self:get_opposite_type(pick_type)

	for _, offset_info in ipairs(self.shoot_offset_infos) do
		offset_info.shoot_type = opposite
	end

	self.character.Position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)

	local int_cnt = integers.Count
	for i = 1, int_cnt - self.empty_proj_count - 1 do
		local index = integers[i]
		self.shoot_offset_infos[index].shoot_type = pick_type
	end
	for i = 1, self.empty_proj_count do
		local index = integers[int_cnt - i]
		self.shoot_offset_infos[index].shoot_type = self.shoot_type.none
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		for i,info in ipairs(self.shoot_offset_infos) do repeat
			if info.shoot_type == self.shoot_type.none then
				break
			end
			battle_range_util.hide(info.attack_range)
			battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, info.attack_range)
			if not is_unity_null(info.cast_fx) then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(info.cast_fx)
			end
			info.cast_fx = nil
			if not is_unity_null(info.proj_fx) then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(info.proj_fx)
			end
			info.proj_fx = nil
		until true end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		-- 캐스팅 sfx
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		for i,info in ipairs(self.shoot_offset_infos) do repeat
			if info.shoot_type == self.shoot_type.none then
				break
			end

			local pos = self.character.Position + info.offset
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(info.attack_range, pos, self.character.Position.y)
			battle_range_util.show(info.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
			battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, info.attack_range)

			local cast_fx = nil
			local proj_fx = nil
			if info.shoot_type == self.shoot_type.unblockable then
				cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('unblockable_cast', pos, vector_util.zero)
				proj_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('unblockable_proj', pos + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.333, -0.275), vector_util.zero)
				proj_fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.projectile_initial_scale
			elseif info.shoot_type == self.shoot_type.blockable then
				cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('blockable_cast', pos, vector_util.zero)
				proj_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('blockable_proj', pos + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.333, -0.275), vector_util.zero)
				proj_fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.projectile_initial_scale
			end
			info.cast_fx = cast_fx
			info.proj_fx = proj_fx
		until true end
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')

		for i,info in ipairs(self.shoot_offset_infos) do repeat
			if info.shoot_type == self.shoot_type.none then
				break
			end

			local shoot_helper = nil
			local label = i
			if info.shoot_type == self.shoot_type.unblockable then
				shoot_helper = self.unblockable_shoot_helper
				label = label + 100
			elseif info.shoot_type == self.shoot_type.blockable then
				shoot_helper = self.blockable_shoot_helper
			end
			if shoot_helper then
				local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + info.offset
				local shoot_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(-info.offset))
				shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, shoot_dir, label, 0, nil, false)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot', shoot_pos)
			end
		until true end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, self.projectile_initial_scale, 1, self.prepare_duration)
		for _,info in ipairs(self.shoot_offset_infos) do repeat
			if is_unity_null(info.proj_fx) then
				break
			end
			info.proj_fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
		until true end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	local target = hit_info.target

	-- fo 충돌 타입이 아니면 그냥 사라짐
	local pos = hit_info.position
	if hit_info.hitType ~= CS.Oak.Projectile.HitType.FieldObject or is_unity_null(target) then
		if label < 100 then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('blockable_end', pos, vector_util.zero)
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('unblockable_end', pos, vector_util.zero)
		end
		return true
	end

	local target_crash_behaviour_type = target.CrashBehaviour:GetType()

	-- 벽과 문은은 관통하게
	if target_crash_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) or
			target_crash_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.OneWayGateCrashBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local is_projectile_shield = target_crash_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ProjectileShieldCrashBehaviour)
	if label < 100 then
		-- blockable
		if not is_projectile_shield then
			local dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(-self.shoot_offset_infos[label].offset))
			self:explosion(pos, dir)
		end
		self.blockable_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('blockable_end', pos, vector_util.zero)
		return true
	else
		-- unblockable
		if not is_projectile_shield then
			local dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(-self.shoot_offset_infos[label - 100].offset))
			self:apply_ailment_only(target, dir)
		end
		self.unblockable_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:explosion(pos, dir)
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(pos, self.explosion_radius, 4)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - pos).normalized
			direction = vector_util.normalized(direction + dir)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = dir
			end

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction

			if self.ailment_gauge > 0 then
				local ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo()
				ailment_info.Ailment = CS.Oak.Ailment.Down
				ailment_info.AilmentGauge = self.ailment_gauge

				--- 상태이상 적용
				damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, ailment_info, 1)
				damage_info.force_ailment = true
			else
				damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
				damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_direction
				damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
			end

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	-- 이펙트 및 사운드
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', pos, vector_util.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', pos)
end

function local_class:apply_ailment_only(fo, dir)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.direction = dir

	if self.ailment_gauge > 0 then
		local ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo()
		ailment_info.Ailment = CS.Oak.Ailment.Down
		ailment_info.AilmentGauge = self.ailment_gauge

		--- 상태이상 적용
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	else
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = dir
		damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.shoot_offset_infos = nil

	self.blockable_shoot_helper = nil
	self.unblockable_shoot_helper = nil
	self.index_table = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--- 18챕터 머니샷(격투게임) 플레이어블 캐릭터의 원거리 공격 (빔타입. 투사체 아님.)
local local_class = newclass('RangeHeavenholdRobotBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration') - 0.2
	local post_action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostActionDuration')
	self.end_action_timing = self.action_duration - post_action_duration

	local action = self.action.animation_info['end']
	local end_anim_duration = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(self.owner.SpineController, action.name)
	action.timescale = end_anim_duration / post_action_duration
	self.action.animation_info['end'] = action

	local cast_action = self.action.animation_info['cast']
	self.cast_end_timing = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(self.owner.SpineController, cast_action.name)

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	self.damage = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Damage')
	self.stun_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StunDuration')
	self.stun_factor = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StunFactor')
	self.knock_back_distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackDistance') * 0.1
	self.knock_back_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackDuration')

	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	self.dash_end_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashEndTiming')
	self.dash_distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDistance')

	--- 판정 박스 캐릭터로부터 적방향 거리
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	self.hit_height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitHeight')
	local max_hit = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxHit')
	local hit_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTerm')

	local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
	--- 판정 박스는 캐릭터 키높이와 Length값, 지속시간은 AttackDuration 만큼 잔류
	local box_height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 피격 판정의 길이
	local box_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	local size = vector(box_length, box_height, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).z)

	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, attack_duration, hit_term, true)
	--- 박스형 충돌 박스
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(
		self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, max_hit
	)

	self.screen_controller = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.GetOrCreateGlobalTable("minigame/RobotFight/Controller/ScreenController")

	self.magnitude = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShakeMagnitude')
	self.shake_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShakeDuration')
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.right
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 격겜이라 오른쪽만 본다.
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 공격 애니메이션
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	local custom_event = CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent.Create(
		self.owner,
		CS.Oak.MoneyShotEventType.ActionStart
	)
	message_system:Publish(custom_event)

	self.screen_controller:set_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5, 0.3)
	self.shake_count = 0
	battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'cast')

end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- end calculator
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	if self.current_time_passed <= self.end_action_timing - 0.1 then
		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector + vector(-1, 5, 0)
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'end', target_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end


	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.attack_fx)
	self.attack_fx = nil

	--if self.current_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
	--end
	self.screen_controller:unset_darken(self.cs_action, 0.35)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing, self.dash_end_timing) then
		if self.dash_distance > 0 then
			local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(time_passed - self.dash_timing, 0, 1, self.dash_end_timing)
			local movement = progress
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			local dir = unity_class.vector3.left

			move_info.direction = dir
			move_info.magnitude = self.dash_distance * movement

			--- dt가 0에 가까우면 일시정지된거일거다. 시간이 흐르지 않게 한다.
			if not float_util.is_almost_zero(dt) then
				local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(dir), false)
				message_system:SendSync(self.owner, move_event)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 연출 시작 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		--- 공격 애니메이션
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'loop')
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
		--- 중심 위치
		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector + vector(-1, 5, 0)

		--- 캐스팅 이펙트, 사운드 재생
		self.attack_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'laser', target_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))
		battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'laser')

		self.screen_controller:shake(0.2, self.cast_end_timing + 0.5 - time_passed)
	end

	--- 판정 체크
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 중심 위치
		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector

		--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, target_pos)
		--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)
		--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			self.shake_count = self.shake_count + 1
			local last_hit = self.shake_count == 3
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, hit_targets[1] == target, last_hit)
			end
			battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'hit')

		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	--- end 연출
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_end_timing +0.2) then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		--- 공격 애니메이션
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'end')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_end_timing + 0.3) then
		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, send_shake, last_hit)
	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	target.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense

	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.damage = self.damage
	damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.EmptyHitEffect.Instance

			self.hit_height,

			self.damage,
			self.stun_duration,
			self.knock_back_distance,
			self.knock_back_duration,
			self.hit_height,
			send_shake and self.magnitude or 0,
			send_shake and self.shake_duration or 0
		)

end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true

	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end
--endregion

	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 수속성 신규 탱커 (adela_noble) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleAdelaNobleBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state
local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 액션 시간
	action_duration = nil,

	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,

	--- 어그로 시간
	aggro_duration = nil,

	--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,

	--- 무기 옵션으로 인한 힐 비율
	heal_ratio = 0
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 어그로 길이
	self.aggro_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AggroDuration')

	self.aggro_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AggroMultiplier')

	self.aggro_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AggroRadius')

	self.aggro_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AggroTerm')

	self.buff_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'BuffName')

	--- info base key
	self.key = {
		cast = 'cast',
		range = 'range',
		range_enhanced = 'range_enhanced',
		cast_end = 'end'
	}

	--- 무기 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)

	self.heal_ratio = 0

	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then
			break
		end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		--- 특수 능력일 경우
		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true

		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true

			--- parsing each info
			battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)

			--- 무기 옵션이 적용된 신규 액션 시간
			self.aggro_duration = self.aggro_duration + cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'AddAggroDuration')

			--- 무기 옵션이 적용된 신규 어그로 범위
			self.aggro_radius = self.aggro_radius * ( 1 + cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'AddAggroRadius'))

			--- 무기 옵션으로 부여되는 힐 비율
			self.heal_ratio = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'HealRatioOnAggro')

		end

	until true end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= self.aggro_radius * 0.8
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	self.total_action_duration = self.action_duration + self.aggro_duration

	self.aggro_terms = {}

	for i = 0, math.floor(self.aggro_duration / self.aggro_term) do
		table.insert(self.aggro_terms, i * self.aggro_term)
	end

end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 초기화
	self.force_cancel = false

	--- set cast anim
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, self.key.cast)
	--- set cast emo
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, self.key.cast)

	local transform = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)

	--- instantiate fx
	local cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(self.action, self.key.cast, self.owner, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, transform)
	
	local fx_scale = self.activate_cwp_option and 1 or 0.85
	cast_fx.transform.localScale = vector(fx_scale, 1, fx_scale)

	--- play cast sfx
	local sfx_key = self.activate_cwp_option and 'cast_enhanced' or 'cast'
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, sfx_key)

	--battle_util.start_effect(self.cs_action, self.owner)

	if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		stage_camera:Shake(0.125, 0.15)
	end

	if self.activate_cwp_option then

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
		heal_info.sender = self.owner
		heal_info.target = self.owner
		heal_info.heal = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(self.owner) * self.heal_ratio)

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
	end

end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	self.aggro_terms = nil
	
	--- 엔드 이펙트는 영역이 전개 되었을 때 강제 취소되면 그때 출력하는 것으로 변경
	if self.current_time_passed > self.action_duration and self.current_time_passed < self.total_action_duration then
		--- 엔드 이팩트
		local end_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action,
			self.key.cast_end,
			self.owner.Position,
			nil,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		local fx_scale = self.activate_cwp_option and 1 or 0.85
		end_fx.transform.localScale = vector(fx_scale, 1, fx_scale)
	end

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.field_fx, self.force_cancel)
	self.field_fx = nil

	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)


	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then

		local key = self.activate_cwp_option and self.key.range_enhanced or self.key.range

		self.field_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action,
			key,
			self.owner.Position,
			nil,
			character_util.get_transform(self.owner)
		)

		buff_util.apply_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_name, self.aggro_duration)
	end

	for _, term in pairs(self.aggro_terms) do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, term) then
			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(
				self.owner.Position, self.aggro_radius
			)

			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target)  then

					local aggro = character_util.get_dps(self.owner) * self.aggro_multiplier

					command_util.publish_aggro_add(self.owner, target, aggro)
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

		end
	end


	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 애니메이션 해지
		battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
		--- 방향 고정 제거
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

		--- 액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end

	if self.field_fx then
		effect_util.update_object(self.field_fx, battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner)))
	end

	--- 어그로 시간 포함 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.total_action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 바케네코 미케 (bakeneko) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleBakenekoBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,

	--- 롤액션 버프 정보
	buff_info = nil,

	--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
	activate_special_option = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 버프 정보
	special_buff_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then
			break
		end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true
			--- 특수 능력 버프 정보
			self.special_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'RoleBuff')

			--- 특능 개화 추가 적용
			self:apply_myth_option(option_param)
		else
			--- 롤액션 버프 정보
			self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param)
		end

	until true end
end

	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')

	--- option id
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)
	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	--- 특수 능력 버프 정보
	self.special_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(myth_option_param, 'RoleBuff')
end

end

	return true
end

	return true

	return true

end

function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- 이모션 설정
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'cast',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner),
		nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
	--- 카메라 쉐이킹
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.play_voice_in_args(self.cs_action, nil, character_voice_type.attack_1)

	--- 버프 부여
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)

	--- 특수 능력 분기
	if self.activate_special_option then
		--- 버프 부여
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.special_buff_info)
	end
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 이모션 해제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	do

	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then

	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)

	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	end
end

end

	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위

	--- 어그로 계수

	--- 반격 버프 정보
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)

	self.buff_id = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(self.buff_info.name).Id

	--- 데미지 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)

	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 처리 함수

	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 구독

				self.activate_cwp_option = true

				--- 무옵 적용중이면 데미지 계수를 덮어씌운다.
				self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'RoleAttackMultiplier')

				--- 무옵 적용시 상태 이상 정보
				self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(option_param, 0)
			end
		until true
	end
end

--- dispose state
function action_state_class:dispose()
	--- 데미지 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)
	--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_damage_event_func = nil

	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 구독 해제
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.buff_expired, self.on_buff_expired_event_func)
	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_buff_expired_event_func = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	self.expired_checker = false

	--- 액션 애니메이션 할당
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'cast',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- 캐스트 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.15)

	--- 반격 버프 적용
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)

	--- 시작하자마자 대상이 존재한다면 도발
	if self.target then
		local aggro = character_util.get_dps(self.owner) * self.aggro_multiplier
		command_util.publish_aggro_add(self.owner, self.target, aggro)
	end
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 버프 해지
	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info.name)

	--- 캐스트 이펙트 해지
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
	--- 캐스트 이펙트 할당 해제
	self.cast_fx = nil

	--- 이모션 해지
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 해지
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if self.action_duration < time_passed and not character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.buff_info.name) then
		--- 특능 적용시 반격 실패 버프 적용되어야 함
		if self.activate_special_option then
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.role_fail_buff_info)
		end

		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 무옵 적용시 상태이상 수치 추가
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 데미지 이벤트 발생
function action_state_class:on_damage_event(e)
	--- 액션 활성화 여부 체크
	if false == self.cs_action.IsActive and false == self.expired_checker then
		return
	end

	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = e.Info

	--- 데미지 정보 오너 체크
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(damage_info.sender, self.owner) then
		return
	end

	--- 데미지 정보 타겟 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(damage_info.target, self.owner) then
		return
	end

	--- 베리어 체크
	if not damage_info.barriered then
		self.expired_checker = false
		return
	end

	--- 오너가 메뉴얼 로컬일때
	if battle_util.is_local_fo(self.owner) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(damage_info.sender, modifier)

		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))

		--- 반격 연출
		self:counter_routine(damage_info.sender)
	else
		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 데미지 센더 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, damage_info.sender)

		--- 싱크 정보 발행
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end
end

--- 버프 만료시 처리
function action_state_class:on_buff_expired_event(e)

	--- 액션 활성화 여부 체크
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- 지금 해제된 버프가 트래킹 중이었던 놈이 맞는가?
	if not buff_util.is_buff_expired(self.buff_id, e) then
		return
	end

	--- 버프 체크
	if character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.buff_info.name) == false then
		self.expired_checker = true

		--- 특능 적용시 반격 실패 버프 적용되어야 함
		if self.activate_special_option then
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.role_fail_buff_info)
		end

		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 카운터 공격 루틴
function action_state_class:counter_routine(target)
	--- 공격 애니메이션 할당(자동 해제됨)
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	--- 공격 이모션 할당 (자동 해제됨)
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')

	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', bounds_util.get_center(target))
	--- 폭발 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'success')
	--- camera shake
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.15)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.action_state:dispose()

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	if self:is_available() == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 정보 싱크
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 스테이트 변경
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	--- 액션이 활성화되어 있는 경우
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))

	--- 센더 추출
	local sender = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)

	if is_unity_null(sender) or character_util.is_dead(sender) then
		return
	end

	--- 반격 연출
	self.action_state:counter_routine(sender)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 크리스마스의 정령 캐럴(captain_rabbit) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleCaptainRabbitBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 길이
	length = nil,
	--- 판정 폭
	width = nil,
	--- 판정 크기
	size = nil,
	--- 판정 시간
	hit_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 버프 정보
	debuff_info = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- setup role action
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 판정 시작 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 판정 길이
	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 판정 폭
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')

	--- apply option
	self:apply_option(param)

	--- 판정 크기
	self.size = vector(self.length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.width)
	--- 판정 시간
	self.hit_duration = self.action_duration - self.hit_timing

	--- 판정체 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(self.size, self.hit_duration, nil, true)

	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

	--- 버프 정보
	self.debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'Debuff')
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- 옵션 데이터 파싱
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 되어있을때
	if activate_option then
		--- 전용 옵션 발동
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- json data parsing
		battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)

		--- 판정체가 커져야할 스케일
		local scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'Scale') + 1

		--- apply scale each factor
		self.length = self.length * scale

		--- 추가타 데미지 배율
		local dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DpsMultiplier')

		--- 추가타 배율 추가
		self.atk_modifier = self.atk_modifier + dps_multiplier
	end
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return distance <= self.length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	local direction = self.dir_vector.x > 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, direction)

	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- set action emotion
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 전용 옵션 발동
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		--- instantiate cast effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- play cast sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
	end

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.05)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- remove emotion
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.05)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 판정 타이밍 직전까지
	if old_time_passed < self.hit_timing and self.target then
		--- 타겟 검증
		if is_unity_null(self.target) or character_util.is_dead(self.target) then
			self.target = nil
		else
			self.dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)
		end
	end

	--- 판정 시작 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- set locked direction
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

		--- character center pos
		local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

		--- set thrust animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'thrust')

		--- instantiate thrust effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'thrust', center + 1.3 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector)

		--- play thrust sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'thrust')

		--- set ik
		spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)

		local spine_controller = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner)
		local deviate_duration = self.action_duration - self.hit_timing

		spine_controller:DeviateLocal(0.8 * self.dir_vector, deviate_duration * 0.8, deviate_duration * 0.2)

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.06, self.action_duration * 0.8)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, center)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기가 작동 중일때
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 판정 타겟
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		--- ifo list 순회
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)

			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.debuff_info)
		end

		--- dispose pooled list
		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	damage_info.direction = self.dir_vector
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(damage_info, 30000)

	--- 전용 옵션 발동
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		--- 힛 이펙트 생성
		damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
			self.action.preset_info['hit'].PresetName, bounds_util.get_center(target), unity_class.vector3.zero, false
		)
	end

	if self.action.sfx_info['hit'] then
		--- 사운드 정보 추가
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)
	end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

		attack_duration - self.expand_start_timing, cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ExpandDuration')
