--- 액션 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_action_state(_)

	--- cancel recoil
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	battle_util.end_effect(self.cs_action, self.owner)

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- 액션 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if old_time_passed < self.hit_timing then
		--- set locked direction
		self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- state reset
		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.hit, self.state.explosion)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.current, self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region explosion state

function local_class:enter_explosion_state(_)
	--- instantiate field fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self,'fire', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * self.sync_dir_vector, self.sync_dir_vector
	)

	--- play field sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'fire')

	stage_camera:Shake(0.05, 0.3)

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.sync_dir_vector)

	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
end

function local_class:exit_explosion_state(_)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- 액션 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_explosion_state(_, time_passed, dt)
	local progress = math.max(math.min((time_passed - self.expand_start_timing) / self.expand_duration, 1), 0)

	self.info.Size = vector(
		self.start_distance + (self.distance - self.start_distance) * progress,
		bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.width
	)

	--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			self:apply_damage(target)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- 공격 완료
	if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.hit, self.state.none)
	end
end

--endregion

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target)
	local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
		self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier
	)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	--- 걸어주는 버프가 추가되었을때 표정 바꿈
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BuffAddEvent) then
		if e.Buff.BuffSpec.Name == self.buff_info.name then
			self.is_buff_active = true

			battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'buff')
		end
	end

	--- 걸어주는 버프가 expired 되었을때 표정을 해지
	if self.is_buff_active and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BuffExpiredEvent) then
		if not character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.buff_info.name) then
			battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action, 'buff')

			self.is_buff_active = false
		end
	end

	return false
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 승급 선산권사 (china_hero_ascent) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleChinaHeroAscentBattleAction')

--region state
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 롤액션용 옵션 활성화 여부
	activate_role_option = nil,
	--- 롤 옵션 id
	role_option_id = nil,

	--- 무기 옵션 활성화 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 장판 생성 타이밍
	self.aoe_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AoeTiming')

	--- 적중 가능한 대상이 있는 경우에만 AI는 쓰도록 세팅
	self.hittable_dist = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AIHittableRange') * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 롤액션 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
	--- 승급 옵션 적용
	self:apply_ascent_option(param)
end

--- 롤액션 옵션 파싱
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 롤액션에서 옵션을 통해 장판을 생성 할것이므로 필수로 필요하다.
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')
	--- 롤액션 옵션 활성화 되어있는지
	local activate_role_option, _ = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)
	--- 옵션 적용 가능 하다면
	if activate_role_option then
		self.activate_role_option = true
		--- 롤액션 옵션 아이디
		self.role_option_id = option_id
	end
end

---- parsing ascent option data
function action_state_class:apply_ascent_option(param)
	--- 무기옵션 Id
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'AscentOptionId')
	--- 옵션 유효성 체크
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if self.activate_role_option and activate_option then
		self.activate_cwp_option = true
		--- 데미지 타입
		self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BaseDamageType')
		--- 공격력 계수
		self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DamageModifier')

		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'Radius')
		local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
		--- 한방 데미지 넣을때 쓸 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(_)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 실제 영역 생성시간
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.aoe_timing) then
		--- 롤 옵션 가지고 있는 경우
		if self.activate_role_option then
			local info = CS.Oak.StageOptionTriggerInfo()
			info.type = CS.Oak.BattleActionTargetType.Position
			info.targetPosition = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
			--- 옵션으로 커맨드 발행
			local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerStageOptionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.owner, self.role_option_id, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.owner.Owner, cmd)
		end

		--- 데미지 주는 각성 찍힌 경우에 데미지 줄수 있도록
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			--- 발동시 데미지
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, character_util.get_position(self.owner))
			--- 데미지 배율
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
			--- 타겟 리스트
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)
			for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
			end

			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	if self:is_available() == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 정보 싱크
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 스테이트 변경
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	--- 액션이 활성화되어 있는 경우
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,

	--- 판정 타이밍
	attack_timing = 0,

	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 사거리
	self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 카메라 쉐이크 변수
	self.shake_amount = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShakeAmount')
	self.shake_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShakeDuration')

	--- 오프셋
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.attack_range
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- camera shake
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, self.shake_amount, self.shake_duration)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 이전 애니메이션을 free_cast 재생을 통해 초기화
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'free_cast')
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- set action emotion
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove emotion
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- sync 용 정보 생성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		local dir_vector = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector)

		--- 포지션 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, character_util.get_position(self.owner) + dir_vector * self.offset)
		--- 방향 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

		--- sync info
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,

	--- 판정 타이밍
	attack_timing = 0,

	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function field_state_class:init(param)
	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 사거리
	self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 히트 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 히트 횟수
	self.max_hit = 1

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

	--- 길이
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 너비
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')

	--- 이펙트 회전각
	self.rotate_angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RotateAngle')

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(vector(length, height, width), self.attack_duration)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 랜덤 방향
	self.rand_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, (random_util.get_random_value() * self.rotate_angle * 2) - self.rotate_angle, 0) * self.dir_vector
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 이펙트 출력
	self.fx_explosion = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.target_pos, self.rand_dir)

	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)

	if direction == direction_util.right or direction == direction_util.down then
		self.fx_explosion.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, -1)
	end
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	self.action:turn_off_shield()

	if self.fx_explosion then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_explosion, true)
		self.fx_explosion = nil
	end

	if self.current_time_passed < 0.6 then
		local fx_end = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'end', self.target_pos, self.rand_dir)

		local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)

		if direction == direction_util.right or direction == direction_util.down then
			fx_end.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, -1)
		end
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 판정 시작 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		self.action:turn_on_shield(self.target_pos, self.dir_vector)

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 판정 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end

			--- 누군가가 판정이 이루어졌으면 바로 나가버림
			self.machine:change(nil)
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function field_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	--- 길이
	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Length')
	--- 높이
	self.height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 너비
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Width')

	self.shield_vfo = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()

	self.shield_vfo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player0
	self.shield_vfo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.ProjectileShieldCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.shield_vfo.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	self.shield_vfo.Owner = c.Owner
	self.shield_vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.shield_vfo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	--- 흡수시 부여할 버프 여기서
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params, 'Buff')

	self.is_in_battle = false

	--- 데미지 이벤트 처리
	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e) self:on_damage_event(e) end
	--- 데미지 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)

	--- 전투 진입 이벤트 처리
	self.on_battle_enter_event_func = function(e) self:on_battle_enter_event(e) end
	--- 전투 이탈 이벤트 처리
	self.on_battle_leave_event_func = function(e) self:on_battle_leave_event(e) end
	--- 전투 시작 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.battle_enter, self.on_battle_enter_event_func)
	--- 전투 종료 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.battle_leave, self.on_battle_leave_event_func)
end

function local_class:dispose()

	self.shield_vfo = nil
	self.is_in_battle = false

	--- 데미지 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)
	--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_damage_event_func = nil

	--- 전투 시작 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.battle_enter, self.on_battle_enter_event_func)
	--- 전투 종료 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.battle_leave, self.on_battle_leave_event_func)
	--- 전투 시작 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_battle_enter_event_func = nil
	--- 전투 종료 이벤트 처리 할당 해제
	self.on_battle_leave_event_func = nil

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	if self:is_available() == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 정보 싱크
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 스테이트 변경
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	--- 액션이 활성화되어 있는 경우
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 정보 싱크
	self.field_state:start(info)
	--- 스테이트 변경
	self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	if not self.field_machine then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

function local_class:turn_on_shield(position, direction)
	--- 투사체 실드는 반드시 전투 중에만 작동되어야 한다.
	if not self.is_in_battle then
		return
	end

	--- 방향 따라서 히트박스를 다르게 설정해줘야 한다.
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(direction.x) then
		self.shield_vfo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(self.width, self.height, self.length))
	else
		self.shield_vfo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(self.length, self.height, self.width))
	end

	self.shield_vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	self.shield_vfo.Position = position
end

function local_class:turn_off_shield()
	--- 투사체 실드는 반드시 전투 중에만 작동되어야 한다.
	if not self.is_in_battle then
		return
	end

	if self.shield_vfo.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
		self.shield_vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.field_machine then
		self.field_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	--- 이벤트 타입 검증
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		return
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.shield_vfo) then
		return
	end

	if self.shield_vfo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
		return
	end

	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = e.Info

	--- 대상이 실드가 아니면 제외
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.shield_vfo, damage_info.target) then
		return
	end

	--- 데미지 타입 체크
	if damage_info.type & CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile ~= CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile then
		return
	end

	--- 히트 이펙트가 없으면 아무 처리 안한다.
	if is_unity_null(damage_info.hitEffect) then
		return
	end

	--- 히트이펙트가 반드시 존재해야 한다!!
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'erase', damage_info.hitEffect:GetHitPosition(self.shield_vfo))

	--- play sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

	--- 흡수 성공했으니 버프 부여
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)
end

function local_class:on_battle_enter_event(e)
	--- 상태 머신이 유효하지 않거나 이미 전투 진입 처리를 한 경우라면 처리할 필요가 없다.
	if self.is_in_battle then return end
	--- 전투에 진입한 것이 자신이 아니라면 생략
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, e.FieldObject) then return end

	--- 상태 변경
	self.is_in_battle = true
end

function local_class:on_battle_leave_event(e)
	--- 상태 머신이 유효하지 않거나 이미 전투 이탈 처리를 한 경우라면 처리할 필요가 없다.
	if not self.is_in_battle then return end
	--- 전투에 이탈한 것이 자신이 아니라면 생략
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, e.FieldObject) then return end
	--- 자신이 속한 전투가 하나라도 있다면 생략
	if battle_manager_util.is_in_battle(self.owner) then return end

	--- 상태 변경
	self.is_in_battle = false
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 수도승 천려 (cyborg_monk) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleCyborgMonkBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 버프 정보
	buff_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 버프 정보
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, _ = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		self.buff_info.level = self.buff_info.level + 1
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(_)
	self.force_cancel = false
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- instantiate effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	--- play sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.15)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0) then
		--- 버프 부여
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)
		--- 디스펠
		buff_util.cure_all_debuffs(self.owner, self.owner)
		--- 싱크 처리
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,

	--- 버프 정보
	buff_info = nil,

	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,

	--- 판정 반지름 (비쥬얼 처리)
	radius = nil,
	--- 구체 이펙트들
	orbit_fx = nil,
	--- 트레일 이펙트들
	trail_fx = nil,
	--- 쿼터니언 캐시
	orbit_quaternion = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function field_state_class:init(param)
	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 버프 정보
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)
	--- 전무 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)

	--- 사용할 버프 정보의 파라미터
	local buff_param = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(self.buff_info.name).Data
	--- 버프 시간
	local duration_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(buff_param, 'Duration')
	local duration_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(buff_param, 'DurationAdd')
	local buff_duration = duration_base + self.buff_info.level * duration_add
	--- 판정 간격
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')

	--- 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxHit')

	--- 판정 반지름
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 정보
	local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.radius, height, buff_duration, damage_term)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

	--- 구체 이펙트들
	self.orbit_fx = {}
	--- 트레일 이펙트들
	self.trail_fx = {}
	--- 쿼터니언 캐시
	self.orbit_quaternion = {}
	--- 마지막 중심
	self.prev_center = nil

	--- 구슬 개수
	local count = 5
	--- 각도 간격
	local angle = 360 / count

	for idx = 1, count do
		table.insert(self.orbit_quaternion, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle * idx, 0))
	end
end

---- parsing option data
function field_state_class:apply_option(param)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, _ = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		self.buff_info.level = self.buff_info.level + 1
	end
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	self:init_orbits()

	--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	self:dispose_orbits()

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(_, time_passed, dt)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	--- 지속되는 동안 판정 처리를 한다.
	local hits = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

	--- 피격자가 있으면 처리하도록
	if #hits > 0 then
		--- 계슈
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 대상 순회
		for _, t in pairs(hits) do
			--- 판정 적용
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
		end

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.02, 0.1)
	end

	--- 판정이 끝나면 상태를 이탈한다.
	if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
		--- 자연 소멸 연출
		self:init_end_orbits(time_passed)
		--- 상태 이탈
		self.machine:change(nil)
	--- 판정이 끝나기 전에만 위치를 갱신한다.
	else
		self:update_orbits(time_passed)
	end
end

function field_state_class:init_orbits()
	local base_vector = vector_util.forward * self.radius
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	local container = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)

	for idx = 1, #self.orbit_quaternion do
		local quaternion = self.orbit_quaternion[idx]
		local offset = quaternion * base_vector

		table.insert(self.orbit_fx, battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(
			self.action, 'proj', self.owner, center + offset, nil, container, parent_follow_flag.none
		))
		table.insert(self.trail_fx, battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(
			self.action, 'trail', self.owner, center + offset, nil, container, parent_follow_flag.none
		))
	end

	self.prev_center = center
end

function field_state_class:update_orbits(time_passed)
	local progress = time_passed * 2.5
	local base_vector = vector(math.sin(progress), 0, math.cos(progress)) * self.radius
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	local keep_prev = vector_util.magnitude(center - self.prev_center) <= 5
	local container = keep_prev and spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner) or nil

	for idx = 1, #self.orbit_quaternion do
		local quaternion = self.orbit_quaternion[idx]
		local fx = self.orbit_fx[idx]
		local trail = self.trail_fx[idx]
		local offset = quaternion * base_vector

		effect_util.update_object(fx, center + offset)

		--- 트레일 위치 갱신
		if keep_prev then
			effect_util.update_object(trail, center + offset)
		--- 트레일은 거리가 너무 벌어지면 다시 생성한다.
		else
			--- 새로 생성
			local new_trail = battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(
				self.action, 'trail', self.owner, center + offset, nil, container, parent_follow_flag.none
			)
			self.trail_fx[idx] = new_trail
			--- 기존 트레일 해제
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(trail)
		end
	end

	self.prev_center = center
end

function field_state_class:init_end_orbits(time_passed)
	local progress = time_passed * 2.5
	local base_vector = vector(math.sin(progress), 0, math.cos(progress)) * self.radius
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	for idx = 1, #self.orbit_quaternion do
		local quaternion = self.orbit_quaternion[idx]
		local offset = quaternion * base_vector

		battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(self.action, 'end', self.owner, center + offset)
	end
end

function field_state_class:dispose_orbits()
	for _ = 1, #self.orbit_quaternion do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(table.remove(self.orbit_fx))
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(table.remove(self.trail_fx))
	end

	self.prev_center = nil
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function field_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 이펙트 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
		self.action.preset_info['hit'].PresetName,
		bounds_util.get_center(t),
		vector_util.zero,
		false
	)

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 장판 상태
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 장판 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

local local_class = newclass('RoleDarkSpiritBattleAction')

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 네크로맨서 녹시아의 소환수(dark_spirit) 역할 기술
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	self.aggro_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AggroMultiplier')

	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')

	role_util.setup_role_action(cs_action, params)

	--- 전용무기 옵션이 발동되었는가?
	self.activate_cwp_option = self:apply_option(self.cs_action, params)

	--- 이번 phase에 실제 영향을 준 IFieldObject
	self.hit_targets = {}

	--region state members region
	do
		--- 내부 스테이트 정의
		self.state = {
			--- 아무것도 안하는 상태
			none = {
				id = 1,
				enter = function(prev_state) end,
				exit = function(next_state) end,
				update = function(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt) end
			},
			--- 액션 상태
			action = {
				id = 2,
				enter = self.enter_action_state,
				exit = self.exit_action_state,
				update = self.update_action_state
			}
		}

		---- 현재 스테이트
		self.current_state = self.state.none

		--- 현재 스테이트에서 지나간 시간
		self.current_time_passed = 0
	end
	--endregion

	buff_util.apply_buff(summonable_util.get_master(self.owner), self.owner, 'buff_partymember_ai', 111, false, false, nil)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.current_state = nil

		for key in pairs(self.state) do
			for inner_key in pairs(self.state[key]) do
				self.state[key][inner_key] = nil
			end

			self.state[key] = nil
		end

		self.state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.hit_targets, self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.hit_targets = nil

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.current_state = new_state

	--- 지나간 시간 리셋
	self.current_time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부

	--- 역할 액션이 available하고 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and
		self.current_state and self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 캐릭터를 제어하지 않음
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지

function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부

end

end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()

	local trigger_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름

	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- clear table
	for key in pairs(self.hit_targets) do

	end

function local_class:cancel()

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

	end

--region action state

--- 액션 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_action_state(_)

	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- play action sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'action')
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'add')

	--- instantiate fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'range',
		self.owner.Position, nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))

	battle_util.start_effect(self.cs_action, self.owner)

	if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then

	end

	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
end

--- 액션 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(
		self.owner.Position, self.radius
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if self.hit_targets[target] == nil and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			local aggro = character_util.get_dps(self.owner) * self.aggro_multiplier

			command_util.publish_aggro_add(self.owner, target, aggro)

			if self.activate_cwp_option then
				self:apply_damage(target)
			end

			self.hit_targets[target] = true
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish

	end

function local_class:apply_option(cs_action, params)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	local master = summonable_util.get_master(self.owner)

	--- 마스터가 옵션을 가지고 있는지 판단
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[1], master)

	if activate_option then
		--- parsing each info
		_, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
			cs_action, option_param, _, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		--- get damage type
		self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BaseDamageType2')

		--- 적에게 입힐 데미지 계수
		self.dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DpsMultiplier2')

		--- 데미지를 줄 경우 추가 옵션 검증
		self.activate_special_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[2], master)

		if self.activate_special_option then
			--- 데미지 비례 회복량 계수
			self.heal_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'HealModifier')
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 소환수 ai 보정
	local ai_modifier = character_util.get_ai_atk_modifier(self.owner)
	--- 소환수 엔티티 아이디
	local owner_id = character_util.get_entity_id(self.owner)
	--- OptionCharacter 형의 소환수
	local option_character = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetSummonableCharacterByEntityId(owner_id)
	--- 공격력 보정 비율
	local ratio = battle_util.get_number(option_character.SummonableCharacterStatsBehaviour.SummonableSpec.AtkRatio)
	--- 공격 모디파이어
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.dps_multiplier)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier / ratio / ai_modifier
	damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
	damage_info.no_critical = true

	local result_info = command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 힐관련 계수가 존재 한다면
	if self.activate_special_option and self.heal_modifier > 0 then
		--- DamageCommand일 경우에만 적용
		--- 크레이그의 '전우 보호'가 발동할 경우 힐하지 않음 (DamageReplaceCommand)
		if result_info then
			self:apply_heal(result_info:GetTotalDamage())
		end
	end
end

--- 흡혈 적용
--- @param damage number 가한 데미지
function local_class:apply_heal(damage)
	if damage > 0 then
		local master = summonable_util.get_master(self.owner)

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = heal_type.drain
		heal_info.sender = self.owner
		heal_info.target = master
		heal_info.heal = math.floor(damage * self.heal_modifier)

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 마왕 리리스(demon_ceo) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleDemonCeoBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end


local state_base = {
	--- state name
	name = nil,
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

function action_state_class:new(parent_class)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:set_param(t, d)
	self.target = t
	self.dir_vector = d
end

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- play action sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'action')

	--- instantiate cast fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', self.owner.Position, nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- 시전 sfx 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		battle_util.start_effect(self.cs_action, self.owner)

		stage_camera:Shake(0.125, 0.15)
	end
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	battle_util.end_effect(self.cs_action, self.owner)

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if old_time_passed < self.action.hit_timing then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action.shoot_timing) then
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		if self.target and battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, self.target) <= self.action.attack_range then
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target.Position))
		else
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, self.owner.Position + self.action.attack_range * self.dir_vector)
		end

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.current_state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region area_state

local area_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action_class = nil,
	--- 판정 위치
	position = nil,
	--- 판정 반지름
	radius = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
area_state_class.mt = { __index = area_state_class }

function area_state_class:new(parent_class)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action_class = parent_class
	return obj
end

function area_state_class:set_param(p)
	self.position = p
	self.radius = self.action_class.radius
end

function area_state_class:enter()
	--- instantiate explosion fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action_class, 'explosion', self.position)

	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action_class, 'explosion', self.position)
end

function area_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	local action = self.action_class
	local owner = action.owner
	local cs_action = action.cs_action

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, action.hit_timing - 0.05) then
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.action_class.owner) then
			stage_camera:Shake(0.125, 0.15)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, action.hit_timing) then
		if action.is_force_canceled == false then
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(cs_action, action.attack_modifier, action.max_hit)

			--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(self.position, self.radius)

			local targets = {}

			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(owner, target) then
					--- apply damage
					action:apply_damage(target, self.position, modifier)

					--- apply debuff
					local buff_result = buff_util.apply_buff_info(owner, target, action.debuff_info)
					--- 디버프 저항 시 추가피해 처리
					if not buff_result and action.activate_awaken_option then
						action:apply_awaken_damage(target)
					end

					table.insert(targets, target)
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			if action.activate_special_option then
				action.option_state:set_param(targets)
				action.option_state_machine:change(action.option_state)
			end
		end

		action.area_state_machine:change(nil)
	end
end

--endregion

--region option_state

local option_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 적에게 입힐 데미지 계수
	dps_multiplier = nil,
	--- 피해를 입힐 타이밍
	hit_timing = {},
	--- 타격 횟수 (데미지 보정 처리 용도)
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 피해를 입힐 대상
	targets = {},
	--- 버프 정보
	buff_info = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
option_state_class.mt = { __index = option_state_class }

--- @param parent_class any 베이스 루아 클래스
--- @param d number 적에게 입힐 데미지 계수
--- @param t table 피해를 입힐 타이밍
--- @param b any 버프 정보
function option_state_class:new(parent_class, atk_modifier, hit_timing, max_hit, b)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj.dps_multiplier = atk_modifier
	obj.hit_timing = hit_timing
	obj.max_hit = max_hit
	obj.buff_info = b
	return obj
end

--- @param t table 피해를 입힐 대상
function option_state_class:set_param(t)
	self.targets = t
end

function option_state_class:enter(_)
	--- apply attack buff
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)
end

function option_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if self.action.is_force_canceled then
		self.action.option_state_machine:change(nil)
		return
	end

	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
				self.cs_action, self.dps_multiplier, self.max_hit
			)

			for _, target in pairs(self.targets) do
				self.action:apply_damage(target, bounds_util.get_center(target), modifier)
			end

			if index == #self.hit_timing then
				self.action.option_state_machine:change(nil)
			end
		end
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase')
	--- max hit
	self.max_hit = 1
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 공격 적중할 거리
	self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackRange')

	--- 판정 범위
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- 옵션이 발동되었는가?
	self:apply_option(params)

	if self.activate_cwp_option == nil then
		role_util.setup_role_action(cs_action, params)

		--- 대상에게 적용할 디버프 파싱
		self.debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params)
	end

	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self)
	self.area_state = area_state_class:new(self)

	self.current_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	self.area_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 강제 캔슬 되었는가
	self.is_force_canceled = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		if self.activate_special_option then
			self.option_state_machine:change(nil)
			self.option_state_machine = nil
		end

		self.current_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.area_state_machine:change(nil)

		self.current_state_machine = nil
		self.area_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.area_state, self.option_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.area_state = nil
		self.option_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 역할 액션이 available하고 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.current_state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, target) <= self.attack_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 캔슬 여부 리셋
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self.action_state:set_param(target, dir_vector)
	self.current_state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local area_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)

	self.area_state:set_param(area_pos)
	self.area_state_machine:change(self.area_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.activate_special_option then self.option_state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.area_state_machine then self.area_state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.current_state_machine then self.current_state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 실제 대상에 데미지 처리
function local_class:apply_damage(target, position, modifier)
	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - position))

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 옵션 적용
function local_class:apply_option(params)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	local option_type = {
		cwp = 1,
		special = 2,
		awakening = 3
	}

	for index = 1, #option_id do
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 되었다면
		if activate_option then
			--- 특수 능력
			if index == option_type.special then
				--- 특수 능력 활성화
				self.activate_special_option = true

				--- 특수 능력이 적용된 계수
				self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DpsMultiplier')

				--- 데미지 타이밍
				local option_hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(option_param, 'HitTiming')
				--- 특수 능력이 적용된 타수
				self.max_hit = self.max_hit + #option_hit_timing

				--- parsing buff
				local buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param)

				--- 옵션 스테이트 생성
				self.option_state = option_state_class:new(self, self.attack_modifier, option_hit_timing, self.max_hit, buff_info)
				self.option_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

			--- 전용 무기 옵션
			elseif index == option_type.cwp then
				--- 전용 무기 옵션
				self.activate_cwp_option = true

				--- 디버프 정보 파싱
				self.debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, false)

				--- 사용 가능 횟수
				local use_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'UseCount')
				--- 사용 쿨
				local cool_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'CoolTime')
				--- 역할군
				local role = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'Role')

				--- 롤 액션 정보 세팅
				role_util.setup_role_action_directly(self.cs_action, use_count, cool_time, role)

			--- 각성 특수 능력
			elseif index == option_type.awakening then
				--- 각성 특수 능력 활성화
				self.activate_awaken_option = true
				--- 옵션 레벨
				local option_level = 0

				--- 캐릭터 인포 체크
				if self.owner.CharacterInfo then
					--- 영웅 옵션 순회
					for _, option in pairs(self.owner.CharacterInfo.CharacterOptions) do
						if option.Id == option_id[index] then
							option_level = option.Level
						end
					end
				end

				--- 각성 특수능력의 damage type
				self.awaken_damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BaseDamageType')

				local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'AtkModifierBase')
				local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'AtkModifierAdd')
				--- 각성 특수능력의 버프 저항시 추가타 배율
				self.awaken_atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * option_level
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 각성 능력 데미지 처리
function local_class:apply_awaken_damage(target)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.awaken_damage_type | damage_attribute_type.passive
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action) | damage_source_type.awakening_option
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = character_util.get_atk_2_dps(self.owner) * self.awaken_atk_modifier

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 유폐된 현자 비네트 (demon_engineer) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleDemonEngineerBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
