--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 개화 베스 (invader_knight_myth) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleInvaderKnightMythBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- HitTiming
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 충돌체 radius
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 해당 캐릭터의 키높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)

	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- hitabble distance
	self.hittable_dist = 5 * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 기본 0
	self.shield_multiplier = 0

	--- 무기 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)

	self:apply_myth_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do
		repeat
			--- 옵션 유효성 확인
			local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

			--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
			if activate_option == false then
				break
			end

			--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
			local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

			if is_special then
				--- 특수옵션 적용 시
				self.activate_special_myth_option = true

				--- 롤액션 추가뎀
				self.role_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'RoleDamageMultiplier')

			else
				--- 무옵 적용 시
				self.activate_cwp_myth_option = true

				--- 개화 무옵 버프
				self.cwp_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Debuff')

				--- 개화 롤액션 버프
				self.role_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'RoleDebuff')

				self.shield_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ShieldMultiplier')
			end
		until true
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 시작 위치
	self.start_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + vector_util.up * 2

	for key in pairs(self.action.hit_target) do
		self.action.hit_target[key] = nil
	end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- cast
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', self.start_pos)
	--- proj
	self.fx_proj = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'proj', self.start_pos, self.dir_vector)
	--- cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 안전하게 선세팅
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + (self.dir_vector * 5)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	if self.fx_proj then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_proj)
		self.fx_proj = nil
	end

	--- 초기화
	for key in pairs(self.action.hit_target) do
		self.action.hit_target[key] = nil
	end

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 구체 크기 증가
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, 0.4) then
		self.fx_proj.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, 0, 1, 0.4)

		-- 회전
		if self.target then
			self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
			self.target_dir = (self.target_pos + unity_class.vector3(0, 2, -2)) - self.start_pos

			effect_util.update_object(self.fx_proj, self.start_pos, self.target_dir)
		else
			self.target_dir = self.dir_vector
		end
	end

	--- 구체 이동
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.4, 0.6) then
		-- 이동
		local target_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.start_pos, self.target_pos, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInCubic(time_passed - 0.4, 0, 1, 0.2))
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_proj, target_pos, self.target_dir)
	end

	--- 히트
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.2)

		--- explosion
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.target_pos)

		--- sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

		if fo_list then
			--- 액션 계수 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 데미지 부여
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(fo, modifier)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = m
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	local result_info = command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 개화 무옵 적용 시
	if self.activate_cwp_myth_option then
		if self.action.hit_target[target] == nil then
			self.action.hit_target[target] = true

			self:apply_shield(result_info, true)
		else
			self:apply_shield(result_info, false)
		end
	end

	--- 개화 특능 적용중일 시
	if self.activate_special_myth_option then
		--- 데미지 정보 생성
		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = damage_attribute_type.melee | damage_attribute_type.passive
		damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
		damage_info.sender = self.owner
		damage_info.target = target
		damage_info.modifier = character_util.get_atk_2_dps(self.owner) * self.role_multiplier
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

		--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	end

	--- 개화 무옵 적용 시
	if self.activate_cwp_myth_option then
		--- 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.cwp_debuff_info)
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.role_debuff_info)
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_shield(result_info, visible)
	if result_info then
		buff_util.add_drain_shield(self.owner, self.owner, result_info:GetTotalDamage(), self.shield_multiplier, visible)
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- 한번이라도 공격 했는지 여부
	self.hit_target = {}
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.hit_target, self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.hit_target = nil
		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	if self:is_available() == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 정보 싱크
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 스테이트 변경
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	--- 액션이 활성화되어 있는 경우
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 비취 주술사 타샤 (jade_shaman) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleJadeShamanBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 소환 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_summon_event_func = function(e) self:on_summon_event(e) end
	--- 소환 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.summon_summonable, self.on_summon_event_func)
	--- 소환해제 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_unsummon_event_func = function(e) self:on_unsummon_event(e) end
	--- 소환해제  이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.unsummon_summonable, self.on_unsummon_event_func)

	--- 소환 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_enable_event_func = function(e) self:on_enable_event(e) end
	--- 소환 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.enable_summonable, self.on_enable_event_func)
	--- 소환해제 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_disable_event_func = function(e) self:on_disable_event(e) end
	--- 소환해제 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.disable_summonable, self.on_disable_event_func)

	--- 무기 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
end

--- dispose state
function action_state_class:dispose()
	--- 소환 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.summon_summonable, self.on_summon_event_func)
	--- 소환 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_summon_event_func = nil
	--- 소환해제 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.unsummon_summonable, self.on_unsummon_event_func)
	--- 소환해제 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_unsummon_event_func = nil

	--- 소환 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.enable_summonable, self.on_enable_event_func)
	--- 소환 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_enable_event_func = nil
	--- 소환해제 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.disable_summonable, self.on_disable_event_func)
	--- 소환해제 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_disable_event_func = nil
end

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 기사 승급 2차 (knight_ascent) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleKnight2AscentBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 넉백 계수
	self.knockback_factor = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackFactor')

	--- 히트 횟수
	self.max_hit = 1

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
	--- 판정 범위
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 지속시간
	local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.radius, height, attack_duration, nil, nil)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

	--- 무기 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 승급 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'AscentOptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 승급 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_ascent_option = true

		--- 승급 시 범위 증가량
		self.ascent_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Buff')
	end

	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then

		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

		--- 회전 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'slash', target_pos, self.dir_vector)

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash')

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash_normal')

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.11)

		--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, target_pos)
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 판정 체크
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then

		--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				local dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, dir)
			end

			--- 각성 강화옵션 적용중이라면
			if true == self.activate_ascent_option then
				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.ascent_buff_info)
			end
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 기사 승급 (knight_ascent) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleKnightAscentBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,

	--- 판정 타이밍
	attack_timing = 0,
	--- 쉐이킹 타이밍
	ground_timing = 0,

	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 사거리
	self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 히트 횟수
	self.max_hit = 1

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
	--- 판정 범위
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 카메라 쉐이킹 타이밍
	self.ground_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'GroundTiming')

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

	--- 무기 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 승급 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'AscentOptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 승급 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_ascent_option = true

		--- 실드 비율
		self.shield_ratio = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ShieldRatio')
		--- 최대 실드 적용 횟수
		self.max_shield_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(option_param, 'MaxShieldCount')
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.attack_range
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 히트 수 리셋
	self.hit_count = 0

	--- 이전 애니메이션을 free_cast 재생을 통해 초기화
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'free_cast')
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.165) then
		--- cast 이펙트 출력 위치
		local look_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3_ver2(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))

		--- 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + look_dir)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 판정 위치
		local attack_pos = nil

		--- 대상이 유효하고 거리 내에 있다면 대상의 위치로 설정함
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) and battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, self.target) <= self.attack_range then
			attack_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target))

		else
			attack_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.attack_range * self.dir_vector)
		end

		--- 번개 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'thunder', attack_pos)
		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'thunder', attack_pos)

		--- 충돌 판정
		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, attack_pos)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end

			--- 승급 옵션 보유 시 자가 실드 부여
			if self.activate_ascent_option then
				self:apply_self_shield(#hit_targets)
			end
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.ground_timing) then
		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.05)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

end

function action_state_class:apply_self_shield(count)
	--- 적용 가능한 횟수를 초과한 경우엔 그만큼 빼준다
	if self.hit_count + count > self.max_shield_count then
		count = self.max_shield_count - self.hit_count
	end

	--- 맞춘 적이 없음..
	if count <= 0 then
		return
	end

	--- 히트 수 갱신
	self.hit_count = self.hit_count + count

	--- 기준이 되는 hp 수치
	local max_hp = character_util.get_max_hp(self.owner)
	--- 쉴드 적용
	buff_util.add_shield(self.owner, self.owner, max_hp * self.shield_ratio * count)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	if self:is_available() == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 먼 대상을 탐색해야 함
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_farthest_target_simple(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)

	--- 분신 외형 상태
	mirage_visual_state = nil,
	--- 분신 이동 상태
	mirage_move_state = nil,

	--- 분신 스파인 로드 완료 여부
	is_mirage_loaded = nil,
	--- 분신 스파인 생성 여부
	is_mirage_ready = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 분신 스파인 최대치
	self.mirage_stack = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MirageStack')
	--- 분신 스파인 알파
	self.mirage_alpha = 0.8

	--- 버프 정보
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)

	--- 사용할 버프 정보의 파라미터
	local buff_param = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(self.buff_info.name).Data
	--- 변신 버프 아이디
	self.mirage_buff_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(buff_param, 'Id')
	--- 현재 변신 중 여부
	self.mirage_activate_count = 0

	self:apply_option(param)

	self.mirage_visual_state = {
		hide = 0,
		show = 1,
		fade = 2
	}
	self.mirage_move_state = {
		none = 0,
		follow = 1,
		follow_custom = 2,
		order = 3
	}

	--- 분신 스파인 생성
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.owner, util.cs_generator(self.create_mirage_spine, self))
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 분신 스파인 최대치
		self.mirage_stack = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(option_param, 'OverrideMirageStack')

		--- 버프 정보
		self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'OverrideBuff')

		--- 사용할 버프 정보의 파라미터
		local buff_param = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(self.buff_info.name).Data
		--- 변신 버프 아이디
		self.mirage_buff_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(buff_param, 'Id')
	end
end

function action_state_class:create_mirage_spine()
	local already_loaded = self.is_mirage_ready

	self.is_mirage_loaded = false
	self.is_mirage_ready = false

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local bundle_name = self.owner.CharacterInfo.AssetName.assetBundleName
	local asset_name = self.owner.CharacterInfo.AssetName.assetName
	local prefab = nil

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, res_holder, bundle_name, asset_name, function(result)
		prefab = result
	end)

	if prefab == nil then
		self.is_mirage_loaded = true
		return
	end

	if not already_loaded then
		self.prev_position = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).position
		self.prev_direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
	end

	for idx = 1, self.mirage_stack do
		local new_object = CS.UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(prefab)
		local new_controller = new_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

		--- 이미 생성된 오브젝트가 있다면 대체한다.
		if already_loaded and idx <= #self.mirage_spines then
			self.mirage_spines[idx]:SwitchSpineController(new_controller)
		--- 새로 생성이 필요한 경우 셋팅해서 등록한다.
		else
			new_object.name = prefab.name .. '_mirage_spine_' .. idx
			new_object.transform.position = self.prev_position
			new_controller.Direction = self.prev_direction
			new_controller:AddColor(self.cs_action.HandleName, unity_class.color(0.4, 0.4, 0.4), 1, 0)
			new_controller:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
			new_controller.SkinName = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner).SkinName
			new_controller:Hide(true)

			if self.owner.CharacterInfo then
				CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetWeaponAttachments(new_controller, self.owner)
			else
				CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetWeaponAttachments(new_controller, self.owner.Weapon1, self.owner.Weapon2)
			end

			self.owner:SetAdditionalSpineController(new_controller)

			table.insert(self.mirage_objects, new_object)
			table.insert(self.mirage_spines, new_controller)
			table.insert(self.current_visual_state, self.mirage_visual_state.hide)
			table.insert(self.mirage_time_passed, 0)
			table.insert(self.current_move_state, self.mirage_move_state.none)
			table.insert(self.current_move_offset, vector_util.zero)
			table.insert(self.move_time_passed, 0)
		end
	end

	res_holder:Dispose()

	self.is_mirage_loaded = true
	self.is_mirage_ready = true
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
	--- 분신이 준비된 상태가 아니라면 생략한다.
	if not self.is_mirage_ready then
		return
	end

	--- 웨폰 어테치먼트 세팅
	if self.owner.CharacterInfo then
		for _, mirage_spine in ipairs(self.mirage_spines) do
			CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetWeaponAttachments(mirage_spine, self.owner)
		end
	else
		for _, mirage_spine in ipairs(self.mirage_spines) do
			CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetWeaponAttachments(mirage_spine, self.owner.Weapon1, self.owner.Weapon2)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:dispose_mirage()
	if self.is_mirage_ready then
		--- 제거가 발생하기 때문에 역순으로 순회
		for idx = #self.mirage_objects, 1, -1 do
			self.owner:RemoveAdditionalSpineController(self.mirage_spines[idx])
			CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.mirage_objects[idx])
			table.remove(self.mirage_objects)
			table.remove(self.mirage_spines)
			table.remove(self.current_visual_state)
			table.remove(self.mirage_time_passed)
			table.remove(self.current_move_state)
			table.remove(self.current_move_offset)
			table.remove(self.move_time_passed)
		end

		self.is_mirage_loaded = false
		self.is_mirage_ready = false
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.is_mirage_loaded
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(_)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 버프 적용
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)

	--- 애니메이션 시작
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 분신 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.09, self.action_duration)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- mirage spine update
function action_state_class:update_mirage_spine(dt)
	--- 분신 세팅이 안되었다면 루틴을 탈 이유가 없음
	if not self.is_mirage_ready then return end

	for idx = 1, self.mirage_stack do repeat
		--- 감춰진 상태라면 아무것도 하지 않는다.
		if self.current_visual_state[idx] == self.mirage_visual_state.hide then
			break
		end

		local old_time_passed = self.mirage_time_passed[idx]
		self.mirage_time_passed[idx] = old_time_passed + dt
		self:update_visual(idx, old_time_passed, self.mirage_time_passed[idx], dt)

		--- 직접 움질일 필요가 없는 경우 생략한다.
		--- none의 경우 hide로 인해 막혀있을 것
		if self.current_move_state[idx] == self.mirage_move_state.order then
			break
		end

		old_time_passed = self.move_time_passed[idx]
		self.move_time_passed[idx] = old_time_passed + dt
		self:update_position(idx, old_time_passed, self.move_time_passed[idx], dt)
	until true end
end

function action_state_class:update_visual(idx, old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	local current_state = self.current_visual_state[idx]

	if current_state == self.mirage_visual_state.fade then
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.1) then
			self:change_visual_state(idx, self.mirage_visual_state.hide)
			self:change_movement_state(idx, self.mirage_move_state.none)
		end
	end
end

--- 분신 스파인의 외형 상태를 변경한다.
function action_state_class:change_visual_state(idx, next_state)
	local current_state = self.current_visual_state[idx]

	if current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if next_state == self.mirage_visual_state.hide then
		--- 스파인 감춤
		self.mirage_spines[idx]:Hide(true)
	elseif next_state == self.mirage_visual_state.show then
		--- 스파인 외형 설정
		self.mirage_spines[idx]:Hide(false)
		self.mirage_spines[idx]:SetAlphaFade(self.mirage_alpha, 0)
		self.mirage_spines[idx]:SetShadowAlpha(1)
	elseif next_state == self.mirage_visual_state.fade then
		self.mirage_spines[idx]:SetAlphaFade(0, 0.1)
	end

	self.current_visual_state[idx] = next_state
	self.mirage_time_passed[idx] = 0
end

function action_state_class:update_position(idx, old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	local current_state = self.current_move_state[idx]

	if current_state == self.mirage_move_state.follow then
		local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
		if look_dir ~= self.mirage_spines[idx].Direction then
			time_passed = 0
			self.move_time_passed[idx] = 0
		end
		local progress = math.min(1, time_passed / 0.1)
		local transform = self.mirage_spines[idx].Transform
		local curr_pos = transform.position
		local target_pos = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).position - direction_util.to_vector3(look_dir) * (0.5 * idx)

		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(curr_pos, target_pos, progress)

		self.mirage_spines[idx].Direction = look_dir
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.sqr_distance(new_pos, curr_pos)) then
			transform.position = new_pos
		end
	elseif current_state == self.mirage_move_state.follow_custom then
		local progress = math.min(1, time_passed / 0.1)
		local transform = self.mirage_spines[idx].Transform
		local curr_pos = transform.position
		local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
		local target_pos = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).position - self.current_move_offset[idx]

		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(curr_pos, target_pos, progress)

		self.mirage_spines[idx].Direction = look_dir
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.sqr_distance(new_pos, curr_pos)) then
			transform.position = new_pos
		end
	end
end

--- 분신 스파인의 움직임을 변경한다.
function action_state_class:change_movement_state(idx, next_state, dir_offset)
	local current_state = self.current_move_state[idx]

	if next_state ~= self.mirage_move_state.none and current_state == self.mirage_move_state.none then
		local pos = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).position
		local dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

		local mirage_spine = self.mirage_spines[idx]
		local target_pos = pos - direction_util.to_vector3(dir) * 0.5
		mirage_spine.Direction = dir
		mirage_spine.Transform.position = target_pos
	end

	if next_state == self.mirage_move_state.follow_custom then
		self.current_move_offset[idx] = dir_offset
	end

	self.current_move_state[idx] = next_state
	self.move_time_passed[idx] = 0
end

--- BuffAddEvent 처리
function action_state_class:on_buff_add_event(e)
	--- 변신 플래그 체크, 버프 아이디 체크
	if self.mirage_activate_count < self.mirage_stack and e.Buff.BuffSpec.Id == self.mirage_buff_id then
		--- 변신 플래그 활성화
		local prev_activate_count = self.mirage_activate_count
		self.mirage_activate_count = self.mirage_activate_count + 1

		for idx = 1, self.mirage_activate_count do
			local mirage_spine = self.mirage_spines[idx]

			self:change_movement_state(idx, self.mirage_move_state.follow)
			self:change_visual_state(idx, self.mirage_visual_state.show)

			if idx > prev_activate_count then
				local offset = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner).y * vector_util.up
				local effect_pos = mirage_spine.Transform.position + offset
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'spawn', effect_pos)
				battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'spawn', effect_pos)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- BuffExpiredEvent 처리
function action_state_class:on_buff_expired_event(_)
	--- 변신 플래그 체크, 버프 잔존 여부 체크
	if self.mirage_activate_count > 0 and self.mirage_activate_count ~= self:get_real_mirage_count() then

		if self.requester then
			self.delay_expired = true
		else
			self:expire_mirage_spine()
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:get_real_mirage_count()
	--- 현재 활성화된 버프를 가져옴
	local active_buffs = self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour:GetActiveBuffs()
	local active_buff_count = 0

	--- 버프 리스트 순회
	for _, buff in pairs(active_buffs) do
		--- 버프 이름 체크
		if buff.BuffSpec.Id == self.mirage_buff_id then
			active_buff_count = active_buff_count + 1
		end
	end

	--- Pooled List 해지
	active_buffs:Dispose()

	--- 실제로 중첩되는 버프가 아니기 때문에 설정된 한도 이하로 보정해서 넘김
	return math.min(active_buff_count, self.mirage_stack)
end

function action_state_class:on_mirage_control_event(e)
	if e.valueType == 1 then
		self.requester = e.requester
		for idx = 1, e.index do
			self:change_visual_state(idx, self.mirage_visual_state.show)
			self:change_movement_state(idx, self.mirage_move_state.follow)
		end
	elseif e.valueType == 2 then
		self.requester = e.requester
		for idx = 1, e.index do
			self:change_visual_state(idx, self.mirage_visual_state.show)
			self:change_movement_state(idx, self.mirage_move_state.follow_custom, e.vectors[idx - 1])
		end
	elseif e.valueType == 3 then
		local idx = e.index
		self:change_visual_state(idx, self.mirage_visual_state.show)
		self:change_visual_state(idx, self.mirage_move_state.order)
		self.mirage_spines[idx].Transform.position = e.vectors[0]
		self.mirage_spines[idx].Direction = vector_util.to_direction(e.vectors[1])
	elseif e.valueType == -1 then
		self.requester = nil
		self:expire_mirage_spine()
	end
end

function action_state_class:expire_mirage_spine()
	if self.mirage_activate_count <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local remain_mirage = self:get_real_mirage_count()

	for idx = remain_mirage + 1, self.mirage_activate_count do
		self:change_visual_state(idx, self.mirage_visual_state.fade)
	end
	for idx = remain_mirage, 1, -1 do
		self:change_visual_state(idx, self.mirage_visual_state.show)
		self:change_movement_state(idx, self.mirage_move_state.follow)
	end
	--- 분신 상태 갱신
	self.mirage_activate_count = remain_mirage
	self.delay_expired = false
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	role_util.setup_role_action(cs_action, params)

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		--- 분신 스파인 제거
		self.action_state:dispose_mirage()
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
				self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 전투가 없다면
	if not battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.owner) then
		--- 플루팅 텍스트를 가져옴
		local floating_text = CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(self.owner)

		--- nil 체크
		if floating_text then
			local text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('sea_witch_role_action_unavailable')
			floating_text:ActivateForManaEmptyText(text, 0, unity_class.color.red)
		end

		--- 액션이 사용 불가능하다는 이벤트 발송
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionUnavailableEvent.Create(self.owner))

		--- 트리거 실패
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함

	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.action_state.buff_info.name)

function local_class:on_event(e)

		self.action_state:on_buff_add_event(e)

	--- 버프 해지 이벤트
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BuffExpiredEvent) then

	--- 분신 제어 이벤트
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleActionMirageEvent) then

		--- 코스튬 교체 이벤트 검증

		end

function local_class:init_message_system()

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent), self.on_battle_leave_event_func)

	--- lua 배틀액션 dispose 타이밍 이슈 방어

	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.action_state.buff_info.name)

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 전설의 용사 에리나(legendary_hero) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleLegendaryHeroBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 길이
	length = nil,
	--- 너비
	width = nil,
	--- 충돌체 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 생성할 보호막 비율
	shield_multiplier = nil,
	--- 전용 옵션 발동
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 전용 옵션 버프 정보
	cwp_buff_info = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 길이
	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 너비
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')

	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
		vector(self.length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.width), nil, nil, true
	)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

	--- 생성할 보호막 비율
	self.shield_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShieldMultiplier')

	--- 옵션 관련 데이터 가져옴
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- 옵션 데이터 파싱
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 되어있을때
	if activate_option then
		--- 전용 옵션 발동
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 전용 옵션 발동시 dps 배수
		self.dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'RoleDpsMultiplier') + 1

		self:apply_myth_weapon_option(option_param)

		--- 무기 옵션 발동된 modifier
		self.atk_modifier = self.atk_modifier * self.dps_multiplier

		--- 전용 옵션 버프 정보
		self.cwp_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param)

		-- 개화 옵션 파싱
		local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(option_param, 'MythOptionId')

		--- loop option id
		local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

		if myth_activate_option then
			--- 전용 옵션 버프 정보
			self.cwp_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(myth_option_param)

			--- json data parsing
			battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, myth_option_param)

		else
			--- json data parsing
			battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_myth_weapon_option(param)
	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	--- 전용 옵션 발동시 dps 배수
	self.dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'RoleDpsMultiplier') + 1
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

	--- set shield animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shield')

	--- set recoil
	character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.3, 0, 0.1, 30)

	--- 전용 옵션 발동 여부 체크
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		--- 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.cwp_buff_info)
	end

	if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		--- 공용 이펙트 적용
		battle_util.start_effect(self.cs_action, self.owner)

		--- 카메라 쉐이크
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.125, 0.15)
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- cancel recoil
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	--- 공용 이펙트 해지
	battle_util.end_effect(self.cs_action, self.owner)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked dierction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대상 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 돌진 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, nil, 0
		)

		--- set recoil
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, -self.dir_vector, 0.7, 0, 0.2, 30)

		--- 대상을 비워줌
		self.target = nil
	end

	--- 판정 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- instantiate shield effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'shield', self.owner.Position, self.dir_vector)

		--- 방패 치기 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shield')

		--- 충돌체 계산기 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 데미지 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, 0)

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
		until true end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		--- 카메라 쉐이크
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.125, 0.175)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_table = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_table.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_table.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_table.sender = self.owner
	damage_table.target = target
	damage_table.modifier = modifier
	damage_table.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_table.stun_duration = 0.4
	damage_table.knock_back_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
	damage_table.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal
	damage_table.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force

	--- 방패만 착용한 상태의 처리
	if character_util.get_dps(self.owner) == 0 then
		--- 방어력 무시
		damage_table.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		--- 데미지 1
		damage_table.damage = 1
	end

	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		--- 힛 이펙트 생성
		damage_table.hit_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
			self.action.preset_info['hit'].PresetName, bounds_util.get_center(target), unity_class.vector3.zero, false
		)
	end

	if self.action.preset_info['optionhit'] then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'optionhit', bounds_util.get_center(target))
	end

	--- 히트 사운드 추가
	damage_table.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit_role')

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	local result_info = command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_table)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 일 경우에 (크레이그 특능 제외)
	if result_info then
		buff_util.add_drain_shield(self.owner, self.owner, result_info:GetTotalDamage(), self.shield_multiplier)
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	role_util.setup_role_action(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 역할 액션이 available하고 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(
		self.cs_action, battle_constants.default_search_range
	)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행

end

--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
