--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 기록실 서기 란 (librarian) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleLibrarianBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 공격 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 공격 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 버프 이펙트
	buff_fx = nil,
	--- 벽력권 이펙트
	charging_fx = nil,
	--- 방향 갱신
	last_direction = nil,
	--- 현재 본
	current_bone = nil,
}

action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 슈터 설정
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 헬퍼, 스펙 설정
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)
	--- 사출 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 폭반 반지름 가져옴
	local radius = projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- 판정 정보 생성
	local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 생성
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info)

	--- 대시 거리
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
	--- 투사체 최대 거리
	local projectile_max_dist =  projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = dash_dist + projectile_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'charge')

	--- 본 세팅
	self:refresh_bone(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))

	--- 이펙트 생성 위치
	local fx_pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(self.current_bone, self.owner)
	--- 차징 이펙트 생성
	self.charging_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'charge', fx_pos, self.dir_vector)

	--- 차지 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'charge')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 점프 요청 취소
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

	--- 차징 이펙트 dispose
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.charging_fx)
	--- 차징 이펙트 할당 해제
	self.charging_fx = nil
	--- 현재 본 할당 해제
	self.current_bone = nil

	--- 애니메이션 제거
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	--- 대상이 존재할 때
	if self.target then
		--- 대상 및 대상 방향 갱신과 함께 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대시 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 움직임을 실행해야할 주체일 경우
		if battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)  then
			--- 인공지능이 아닌 경우
			if not battle_util.is_ai(self.cs_action) then
				--- 조작 방향 가져오기
				local stick_direction = battle_util.get_raw_stick_direction(self.cs_action)

				--- 조작 방향이 유효한 경우
				if vector_util.magnitude(stick_direction) > 0 then
					--- 대시 싱크 용 정보 생성
					local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
					--- 대시 방향 정보 추가
					trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, stick_direction)
					--- 싱크 커맨드 발행
					command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
				end

			--- 인공지능인 경우
			else
				--- 대시 싱크 용 정보 생성
				local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
				--- 대상 정보 추가
				trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
				--- 대시 방향 정보 추가
				trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
				--- 싱크 커맨드 발행
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 차지 이펙트가 있는 경우
	if self.charging_fx then
		--- 현재 바라보는 방향
		local cur_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
		--- 방향 전환됐을때
		if cur_dir ~= self.last_direction then
			--- 현재 본 갱신
			self:refresh_bone(cur_dir)
		end

		--- 이펙트 위치 계산
		local fx_pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(self.current_bone, self.owner)
		--- 이펙트 위치 갱신
		effect_util.update_object(self.charging_fx, fx_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 발사 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- 차지 이펙트 dispose
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.charging_fx)
		--- 차지 이펙트 할당 해제
		self.charging_fx = nil

		--- 투사체 발사
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
			self.shoot_helper[1], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 보이스 랜덤 밸류
		local voice_random_value = random_util.get_random_value() * 3
		--- 보이스 타입 선택
		local voice_type = voice_random_value < 1 and
			CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack1 or
			voice_random_value < 2 and CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack2 or CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack3
		--- 보이스 재생
		battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, voice_type)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:always_update(_)
	--- 남은 사용 횟수
	local use_left = role_util.get_use_left(self.cs_action)

	if self.buff_fx then
		if use_left == 0 then
			--- reset hit count
			self.current_hit_count = 0
			--- 버프 이펙트 dispose
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.buff_fx)
			--- 버프 이펙트 할당 해지
			self.buff_fx = nil

			if self.owner then
				--- 만료 이펙트 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self.action, 'expire',
					character_util.get_position(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
				)
			end
		end
	else
		if use_left > 0 then
			--- 버프 이펙트 생성
			--- [부쉬] 이펙트 오너쉽 부여
			self.buff_fx = battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(
				self.action, 'buff', self.owner,
				character_util.get_position(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
			)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:refresh_bone(dir)
	--- 방향 갱신
	self.last_direction = dir

	--- 슬롯 이름
	local slot_name = (self.last_direction & CS.Oak.Direction.Down) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None and
		'[base]weapon2' or
		'[base]weapon1'

	--- 현재 본
	self.current_bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.owner, slot_name).Bone
end

function action_state_class:on_explosion(pos)
	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec[1], pos)

	--- 실제로 동작할 필요가 있는지 체크
	if not battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner) then return end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, pos)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- ifo 순회
	for _, each_target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
		--- 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(each_target)
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.3)
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- 계수 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.proj_spec[1].AttackModifier)

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = direction

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	--- 넉백 세팅
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(
		damage_info, knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force, projectile_spec_util.get_knock_back_factor(self.proj_spec[1])
	)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function action_state_class:start_dash(info)
	--- 싱크된 타겟
	local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 싱크된 대시 방향
	local dash_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 대시하지 않아야 하는 거리
	local no_dash_dist = battle_util.is_ai(self.cs_action) and 3 or 0

	--- 대시 요청
	battle_util.melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_action, target, dash_dir_vector,
		0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		nil, false, no_dash_dist
	)

	--- 점프 요청
	character_util.jump(self.owner, 0.2, self.dash_duration)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 스테이트 클래스
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, params)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		--- 스테이트 머신 비워줌
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		--- 스테이트 머신 할당 해제
		self.state_machine = nil

		--- 액션 스테이트 값 비워줌
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)
		--- 액션 스테이트 할당 해제
		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해제
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 대시 시작
	self.action_state:start_dash(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 항상 업데이트할 부분
	if self.action_state then self.action_state:always_update(dt) end
	--- 내부 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.action_state == nil then return true end

	--- 무언가에 부딪히면 폭발한다
	self.action_state:on_explosion(hit_info.position)

	return true
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 리나(lina) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleLinaBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 최대 거리
	max_dist = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 캐스팅 이펙트
	cast_fx = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 투사체 속도
	local speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Speed')
	--- 투사체 생명 주기
	local life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LifeTime')

	--- 최대 거리
	self.max_dist = speed * life_time
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(t)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, t)

	return distance <= self.max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set upper animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 캐릭터 반동
	character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.2, 0.1, self.shoot_timing)

	--- instantiate cast effect
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', self.owner.Position, nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.06, 0.2)

	--- 랜덤 밸류
	local value = random_util.get_random_value() * 3

	if value < 1 then
		--- 재생할 보이스 선택
		local voice_type = value < 0.5 and
			CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack1 or CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack2

		---보이스 재생
		battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, voice_type)
	end
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- dispose cast fx
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
	self.cast_fx = nil

	--- remove upper animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- update target direction
	if self.target then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- shoot timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- dispose cast fx
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
		--- 이펙트 비움
		self.cast_fx = nil

		--- 타겟이 유효한가
		local valid_target = self.target and battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, self.target) <= self.max_dist

		--- 목표 위치
		local target_pos = valid_target and
			battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target)) or
			battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.max_dist)

	--- 싱크 정보
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 발사 위치
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 1.5 * vector_util.up)

		--- 목표 위치
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, target_pos)

		--- 커맨드 발행
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region proj state

local proj_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 투사체 속도
	speed = nil,
	--- 투사체 생명 주기
	life_time = nil,
	--- 투사체 폭발 범위
	radius = nil,
	--- 적중시 사용할 버프 정보
	buff_info = nil,
	--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 무기 옵션 발동 중 적중시 회복할 마나량
	mana_regen_amount = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 투사체 테이블
	proj = {
		--- 투사체 이펙트
		fx = {},
		--- 트레일 이펙트
		trail = {},
		--- 생성된 뒤 지나간 시간
		time_passed = {},
		--- 생존 주기
		life_time = {},
		--- 발사 위치
		start_pos = {},
		--- 대상 위치
		target_pos = {}
	},
}
proj_state_class.mt = { __index = proj_state_class }

--- create proj state
function proj_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

--- init proj state class
function proj_state_class:init(param, _)
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- 투사체 속도
	self.speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Speed')
	--- 투사체 생명 주기
	self.life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LifeTime')
	--- 투사체 폭발 범위
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	--- 적중시 사용할 버프 정보
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)

	--- 옵션 관련 데이터 가져옴
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function proj_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- parsing each info
		battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)

		--- 사용 가능 횟수
		local use_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'UseCount')
		--- 사용 쿨
		local cool_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'CoolTime')
		--- 역할군
		local role = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'Role')

		role_util.setup_role_action_directly(self.cs_action, use_count, cool_time, role)

		--- 무기 옵션 발동된 modifier
		self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'OverrideModifier')

		--- 적중시 회복할 마나량
		self.mana_regen_amount = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ManaRegenAmount')

		return
	end

	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)
end

function proj_state_class:force_cancel()
	for index = #self.proj.fx, 1, -1 do
		self:clear_proj(index)
	end
end

--- 프로젝타일 추가
function proj_state_class:add_proj(info)
	local start_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	local target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 1)

	local diff = target_pos - start_pos
	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

	local fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'proj', start_pos, dir_vector)
	local trail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'trail', start_pos, dir_vector)

	table.insert(self.proj.fx, fx)
	table.insert(self.proj.trail, trail)
	table.insert(self.proj.time_passed, 0)
	table.insert(self.proj.life_time, magnitude / self.speed)
	table.insert(self.proj.start_pos, start_pos)
	table.insert(self.proj.target_pos, target_pos)
end

--- drain state exit
function proj_state_class:exit(_)
	self:force_cancel()
end

--- action state update
--- @param dt number delta time
function proj_state_class:update(_, _, dt)
	for index = #self.proj.fx, 1, -1 do
		self.proj.time_passed[index] = self.proj.time_passed[index] + dt

		local progress = self.proj.time_passed[index] / self.proj.life_time[index]

		local current_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.proj.start_pos[index], self.proj.target_pos[index], progress)

		--- update fx position
		self.proj.fx[index].transform.localPosition = current_pos
		self.proj.trail[index].transform.localPosition = current_pos

		--- expired
		if progress >= 1 then
			--- on explosion
			self:on_explosion(self.proj.target_pos[index])

			--- clear proj
			self:clear_proj(index)
		end
	end

	--- overflow 를 막기 위함
	self.current_time_passed = 0
end

function proj_state_class:clear_proj(index)
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj.fx[index])
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj.trail[index])

	table.remove(self.proj.fx, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.trail, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.time_passed, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.life_time, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.start_pos, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.target_pos, index)
end

--- explosion routine
function proj_state_class:on_explosion(position)
	--- instantiate explosion effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', position + 0.1 * vector_util.up)

	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	--- modifier 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

	--- 대상 존재 여부
	local exist_target = false

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(position, self.radius)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, true)

			exist_target = true
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	if exist_target then
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			command_util.publish_mana_recover(self.owner, self.owner, self.mana_regen_amount)
		end

		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)
	end

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.2)
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function proj_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- proj state
	self.proj_state = proj_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- state machine
	self.proj_machine = simple_state_machine:new(self.proj_state, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 역할 액션이 available하고 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()

--- 18챕터 기사 무기 스위칭 기믹용 롤액션
local local_class = newclass('RoleLwBossKnightBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 롤액션 버프 정보
	buff_info = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	self.weapon_type =
	{
		sword = 1,
		bow = 2,
	}

	self.weapon_rarity =
	{
		libera = 1,
		champion = 2,
	}

	--- 역할 액션 세팅
	role_util.setup_role_action(self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	self.weapon_sword = nil
	self.weapon_bow = nil

	self.champion_sword = nil
	self.champion_bow = nil

	self.cwp_sword_cost = 85
	self.cwp_bow_cost = 120

	self.is_disable_ctl = false

	local bs_name = self.owner.FieldObjectBehaviour.BattleStyleSpec.Name
	self.current_weapon = bs_name == 'lw_boss_knight2' and self.weapon_type.bow or self.weapon_type.sword
	self.current_weapon_rarity = self.weapon_rarity.libera

	--- 버프 파싱
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)

	self:load_weapons(param)
end

function action_state_class:load_weapons(param)
	-- 검 스펙
	local id, spec

	id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'SwordId')
	spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(id)
	self.weapon_sword = CS.Oak.Item.Create(spec, nil, nil, self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Level)

	-- 활 스펙
	id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'BowId')
	spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(id)
	self.weapon_bow = CS.Oak.Item.Create(spec, nil, nil, self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Level)

	-- 챔피언 소드
	id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'ChampionSwordId')
	spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(id)
	self.champion_sword = CS.Oak.Item.Create(spec, nil, nil, self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Level)

	-- 챔피언 보우
	id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'ChampionBowId')
	spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(id)
	self.champion_bow = CS.Oak.Item.Create(spec, nil, nil, self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Level)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(_)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	local target_weapon = self.current_weapon == self.weapon_type.sword and self.weapon_type.bow or self.weapon_type.sword
	self:change_weapon(target_weapon, true, true, true)
end

function action_state_class:change_weapon(weapon_type, add_buff, disable_control, show_effect)
	if show_effect then
		--- 애니메이션 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
		--- 이모션 설정
		battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
		--- 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.left)
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
		battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
	end

	if add_buff then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info, false, false)
	end

	local state = self.owner.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	if disable_control and state ~= nil and	lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		self.owner.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RequestDisableControl(self.owner, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
		self.is_disable_ctl = true
	end

	if self.current_weapon_rarity == self.weapon_rarity.champion then
		local weapon = weapon_type == self.weapon_type.bow and self.champion_bow or self.champion_sword
		self.owner:SetEquipmentWithClass(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, weapon, 'lw_boss_knight_champion')

	else
		local weapon = weapon_type == self.weapon_type.bow and self.weapon_bow or self.weapon_sword
		self.owner:SetEquipmentWithClass(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, weapon, 'lw_boss_knight')
	end

	self.current_weapon = weapon_type
end

function action_state_class:change_weapon_rarity(weapon_rarity)
	if self.current_weapon_rarity == weapon_rarity then
		return
	end

	self.current_weapon_rarity = weapon_rarity
	self:change_weapon(self.weapon_type.sword, false, false, false)
end

function action_state_class:set_character_mana()
	if self.current_weapon == self.weapon_type.sword then
		self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Mana = self.cwp_sword_cost

	elseif self.current_weapon == self.weapon_type.bow then
		self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Mana = self.cwp_bow_cost
	end
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	local state = self.owner.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	if self.is_disable_ctl and state ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		self.owner.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RemoveDisableControl(self.owner)
	end

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- statlue reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionsChangedEvent), 'on_battle_actions_changed_event')
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local str = e:GetParamAt(0)
	if str == 'lw_knight_force_weapon_change_to_sword' then
		self.action_state:change_weapon(1, false, false, false)

	elseif str == 'lw_knight_force_weapon_change_to_bow' then
		self.action_state:change_weapon(2, false, false, false)

	elseif str == 'lw_knight_champion_weapon_change' then
		self.action_state:change_weapon_rarity(self.action_state.weapon_rarity.champion)
		self.action_state:change_weapon(1, false, false, false)
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_actions_changed_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.owner) then
		return
	end

	self.action_state:set_character_mana()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionsChangedEvent))

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	local state = self.owner.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	local is_manual = state ~= nil and	lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState)

	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state() and is_manual
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부

	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)

end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 힐 타이밍
	self.heal_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealTiming')
	--- 힐 타이밍
	self.heal_ratio = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealRatio')
	--- 힐 타이밍
	self.self_ratio = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SelfHealRatio')

	--- 대시 거리
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)
	--- 무기 옵션 스펙 적용
	if activate_option then
		self.activate_cwp_option = true
		self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param)
	end

	option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'SpecialOptionId')
	activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)
	--- 특수 옵션 스펙 적용
	if activate_option then
		self.activate_special_option = true

		--- 힐량 비례 실드 계수
		self.shield_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ShieldMultiplier')
	end
end

function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 사이의 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- 사거리 판정
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 이펙트 설정
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.18)

	--- 전무 옵션 발동
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)
	end

	--- 스페셜 대사 재생
	battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Special3)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(next_state)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 대상이 없으면 대시하지 않는다.
		if self.target then
			--- 대시 요청
			battle_util.melee_short_dash(
				self.cs_action,
				self.target,
				self.dir_vector,
				0,
				self.dash_duration,
				self.dash_speed,
				self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
				nil,
				false,
				0
			)
		end

		--- 애니 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'dash')
	end

	--- 힐 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.heal_timing) then
		--- 대상 힐
		if battle_util.can_apply_heal(self.owner, self.target, false) then
			self:apply_heal(self.target, self.heal_ratio)
		end
		--- 자힐
		if battle_util.can_apply_heal(self.owner, self.owner, false) then
			self:apply_heal(self.owner, self.self_ratio)
		end
	end

	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_heal(target)
	local is_self = lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, target)
	local heal_ratio = is_self and self.self_ratio or self.heal_ratio

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(target) * heal_ratio)

	--- 다른 대상의 힐 부여인 경우 이펙트를 추가한다.
	if not is_self then
		heal_info.healEffect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
			self.action.preset_info['heal'].PresetName,
			character_util.get_position(target),
			vector_util.zero,
			false
		)
		heal_info.healSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['heal'].sfxName)
	end

	--- 힐 부여
	local result_info = command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	buff_util.cure_all_debuffs(self.owner, target)

	--- 특수 옵션 보유 시 추가적으로 실드 부여
	if self.activate_special_option and result_info then
		--- 부여한 힐 량에 비례하여 보호막을 부여한다.
		buff_util.add_shield(self.owner, target, heal_info_util.get_heal_amount(result_info) * self.shield_multiplier)
	end
end

	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info

	if self.sync_target then
		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(self.sync_target.Position, self.radius)

		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			if self.hit_targets[target] == nil then
				--- 기존 코드 호환 풀피여도 힐함
				if battle_util.can_apply_heal(self.owner, target, false) then
					self:apply_heal(target)
					self.hit_targets[target] = true

				--- 전용무기 옵션이 발동되어 있고 적대 대상이라면
				elseif self.activate_cwp_option and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					self:apply_damage(target)

					self.hit_targets[target] = true
				end
			end
		end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function local_class:apply_option(cs_action, params)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	for index = 1, #option_id do
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		if activate_option then
			local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

			if is_special then
				self.activate_special_option = true

				--- 추가 사용 회수
				self.use_count = self.use_count + cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(option_param, 'AdditionalCount')
			else
				self.activate_cwp_option = true

				--- get damage type
				self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BaseDamageType')

				local radius_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'RadiusScale') + 1

				self.radius = self.radius * radius_scale

				--- 적에게 입힐 데미지 계수
				self.dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DpsMultiplier')

				--- 회복량 비례 쉴드 계수
				self.shield_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ShieldMultiplier')

				--- 대상틀 탐색할 거리
				self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'SearchRange')
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.dps_multiplier)
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.1

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 실제 힐 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_heal(target)
	--- 사용 횟수가 제한된 액션이기 때문에 전투인지 검사를 하지 않음
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(character_util.get_recovery(self.owner) * self.heal_multiplier)
	heal_info.healEffect = CS.Oak.BasicHealEffect.Instance
	heal_info.healSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_magic_heal_02')

	local result_info = command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	buff_util.cure_all_debuffs(self.owner, target)

	if self.activate_cwp_option and result_info then
		--- 부여한 힐 량에 비례하여 보호막을 부여한다.
		buff_util.add_shield(self.owner, target, heal_info_util.get_heal_amount(result_info) * self.shield_multiplier)
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 전쟁 청부업자 오르카(mercenary) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleMercenaryBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 지뢰를 투척할 최대 거리
	max_dist = nil,
	--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	--- 지뢰를 투척할 최대 거리
	self.max_dist = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxDist')

	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then
			break
		end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		--- 무기 옵션일 경우
		if is_special == false then
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true
		end

	until true end
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return distance <= self.max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set upper animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 캐릭터 반동
	character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.2, 0.1, 0.08)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- canecl recoil
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	--- remove upper animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- shoot timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- shoot pos
		local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

		--- 타겟이 유효한가
		local valid_target = self.target and
			battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, self.target) <= self.max_dist

		local target_pos = valid_target and
			self.target.Position or self.owner.Position + self.max_dist * self.dir_vector

		--- extension cache
		local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

		local diff = target_pos - shoot_pos
		--- distance
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
		local bounds = bounds_util.get_obb_bounds(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), bounds_util.get_size(self.owner) * 2, 0)

		local shoot_dist = dist

		--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
		local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
			bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, dist * self.dir_vector
		)

		if closest_object then
			--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
			shoot_dist = math.min(
				bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), self.dir_vector), dist
			)

			if shoot_dist < dist then
				target_pos = shoot_pos + shoot_dist * self.dir_vector
			end
		end

		self.action.mine_state:spawn(shoot_pos, battle_util.get_ground_pos(target_pos), shoot_dist)

		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'mine')

		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			local angle = math.acos(((dist * dist * 2 - 1) / (2 * dist * dist)))

			--- check nan
			if angle ~= angle then
				angle = 0
			end

			local dir1 = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(math.deg(-angle), vector_util.up) * self.dir_vector
			local pos1 = shoot_pos + dist * dir1

			shoot_dist = dist

			--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
			closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
				bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, dist * dir1
			)

			if closest_object then
				--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
				shoot_dist = math.min(
					bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), dir1), dist
				)

				if shoot_dist < dist then
					pos1 = shoot_pos + shoot_dist * dir1
				end
			end

			self.action.mine_state:spawn(shoot_pos, battle_util.get_ground_pos(pos1), shoot_dist)

			local dir2 = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(math.deg(angle), vector_util.up) * self.dir_vector
			local pos2 = shoot_pos + dist * dir2

			shoot_dist = dist

			--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
			closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
				bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, dist * dir2
			)

			if closest_object then
				--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
				shoot_dist = math.min(
					bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), dir2), dist
				)

				if shoot_dist < dist then
					pos2 = shoot_pos + shoot_dist * dir2
				end
			end

			self.action.mine_state:spawn(shoot_pos, battle_util.get_ground_pos(pos2), shoot_dist)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

	self.life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LifeTime')
	--- 폭발 반경
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	--- 이동 속도
	self.move_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MoveSpeed')
	--- 가속도
	self.accel = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Accel')
	--- 최대 속도
	self.max_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxSpeed')

	--- 지뢰가 대상을 추적함 범위
	self.mine_search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MineSearchRange')

	--- 디버프 정보
	self.debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'Debuff')

	self:apply_option(param)

	--- 개화 옵션 오버라이드
	self:apply_myth_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function mine_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then
			break
		end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		--- 특수 능력일 경우
		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true

			--- 판정시 버프
			self.special_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'HitBuff')

			--- 개화가 존재한다면 개화 옵션 적용
			local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(option_param, self.owner)

			if has_myth_option then
				--- 판정시 버프 오버라이드
				self.special_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(myth_param, 'HitBuff')

				--- 속깎 디버프 오버라이드
				self.debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(myth_param, 'Debuff')
			end
		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true

			--- 적중시 감소할 재사용 시간
			self.reduce_cool_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ReduceCoolTime')

			--- 개화가 존재한다면 개화 옵션 적용
			local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(option_param, self.owner)

			if has_myth_option then
				--- 데미지 오버라이드
				self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'ModifierBase')
			end
		end

	until true end
end

---- parsing option data
function mine_state_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then
		return
	end

	--- 지뢰가 대상을 추적함 범위 오버라이드
	self.mine_search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'MineSearchRange')

	--- 폭발 반경 오버라이드
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'Radius')
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function mine_state_class:spawn(start_pos, target_pos, distance)
	local mine = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'mine', start_pos)

	local life_time = distance / self.speed

	local mine_spine = mine:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	mine_spine:Jump(0.5, life_time)

	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	mine_spine:ClearTrack(spine_track)
	mine_spine:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'idle', true)

	local light = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'light', start_pos)
	local bone_follower = light:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))

	bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = mine_spine.SkeletonAnimation
	bone_follower.boneName = 'body'

	table.insert(self.mine.fx, mine)
	table.insert(self.mine.light, light)
	table.insert(self.mine.time_passed, 0)
	table.insert(self.mine.throw_life_time, life_time)
	table.insert(self.mine.start_pos, start_pos)
	table.insert(self.mine.target_pos, target_pos)
	table.insert(self.mine.target, self.owner)
	table.insert(self.mine.speed, self.move_speed)
end

function mine_state_class:force_cancel()
	--- 지뢰 루프
	for index = #self.mine.fx, 1, -1 do
		--- instantiate explosion effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.mine.fx[index].transform.localPosition)

		self:remove_mine(index)
	end
end

function mine_state_class:enter(_)
end

--- action state exit
function mine_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 지뢰 루프
	for index = #self.mine.fx, 1, -1 do
		--- instantiate explosion effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.mine.fx[index].transform.localPosition)

		self:remove_mine(index)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param dt number delta time
function mine_state_class:update(_, _, dt)
	--- 지뢰 루프
	for index = #self.mine.fx, 1, -1 do
		--- 이펙트의 위치
		local last_pos = self.mine.fx[index].transform.localPosition
		local current_pos = last_pos

		local old_time_passed = self.mine.time_passed[index]
		local time_passed = old_time_passed + dt

		if old_time_passed < self.mine.throw_life_time[index] then
			local progress = time_passed / self.mine.throw_life_time[index]
			current_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.mine.start_pos[index], self.mine.target_pos[index], progress)

			effect_util.update_object(self.mine.fx[index], current_pos)

			if self.mine.throw_life_time[index] < time_passed then
				self.mine.throw_life_time[index] = 0
				time_passed = 0
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(self.mine.target[index], self.owner) then
			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(current_pos, self.mine_search_range)

			--- target loop
			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					--- set target
					self.mine.target[index] = target

					local mine_spine = self.mine.fx[index]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
					--- mine spine jump
					mine_spine:Jump(0.5, 0.5)

					--- set anim
					local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
					mine_spine:ClearTrack(spine_track)
					mine_spine:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'jump', false, 1, nil, nil, 'walk')

					--- dispose light
					effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.mine.light[index])

					--- instantiate red light effect
					local light = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'red', current_pos)
					local bone_follower = light:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))

					--- set bone follower
					bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = mine_spine.SkeletonAnimation
					bone_follower.boneName = 'body'

					--- set new light fx
					self.mine.light[index] = light

					--- play target sfx
					local holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'target')

					self.sfx_holder[self.mine.fx[index]] = holder

					break
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()
		else
			local t = self.mine.target[index]

			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
				local delta_speed = dt * self.accel
				local movement = math.min(self.mine.speed[index] + 0.5 * delta_speed, self.max_speed) * dt

				self.mine.speed[index] = self.mine.speed[index] + delta_speed

				local direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(character_util.get_position(t) - last_pos))

				current_pos = last_pos + movement * direction

				effect_util.update_object(self.mine.fx[index], current_pos)
			end
		end

		local hit = false

		do
			local move_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(current_pos - last_pos)
			local normal_vector = vector_util.normalized(move_vector)

			local projectile_size = vector(1, 0.25, 1)
			local size = projectile_size + vector_util.magnitude(move_vector) * vector_util.right
			local center = (current_pos + last_pos) * 0.5
			local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(normal_vector.z, normal_vector.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg

			local origin_bounds = bounds_util.get_obb_bounds(last_pos, projectile_size, angle)

			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_collided_by(origin_bounds, move_vector)

			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do

				local hittable = battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target)
				local crash = lua_helper.reference_equals(self.mine.target[index], self.owner) == false and
					lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, target) == false

				if (hittable or crash) and
					bounds_util.is_intersecting_obb(bounds_util.get_bounds(target), center, size, angle) then

					hit = true

					local target_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(target)
					local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(origin_bounds, target_bounds, normal_vector)

					--- move_vector y 성분 보존 하는 방향으로 로직을 바꾸는 게 좋지만,
					--- 기존 캐릭터 조작감에 미묘한 영향이 있을 것이므로, 건드리지 않고 ray_dist 최대값만 제한한다.
					ray_dist = math.min(ray_dist, vector_util.magnitude(move_vector))
					local hit_pos = last_pos + ray_dist * normal_vector

					current_pos = hit_pos

					effect_util.update_object(self.mine.fx[index], current_pos)

					break
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()
		end

		self.mine.time_passed[index] = time_passed

		--- expire
		if self.life_time <= time_passed or hit then
			--- on explosion
			self:on_explosion(current_pos)

			--- remove mine
			self:remove_mine(index)
		end
	end

	self.current_time_passed = 0
end

function mine_state_class:on_explosion(position)
	--- instantiate explosion effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', position)

	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	local exist_target = false

	--- atk modifier
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(position, self.radius)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)

			exist_target = true
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	if exist_target then
		if self.activate_special_option then
			--- apply debuff info
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.special_buff_info)
		end

		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			CS.Oak.IRoleBattleActionExtensions.UpdateCooltime(self.cs_action, self.reduce_cool_time)
		end
	end

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.075, 0.1)
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function mine_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- apply debuff info
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.debuff_info)
end

function mine_state_class:remove_mine(index)
	local mine = self.mine.fx[index]

	local mine_spine = mine:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	--- clear track
	mine_spine:ClearTrack(spine_track)
	--- cancel jump
	mine_spine:CancelJump()

	sfx_util.fade_out(self.sfx_holder[mine], 0.2)
	self.sfx_holder[mine] = nil

	--- dispose light
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.mine.light[index])
	--- dispose mine
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(mine)

	table.remove(self.mine.fx, index)
	table.remove(self.mine.light, index)
	table.remove(self.mine.time_passed, index)
	table.remove(self.mine.throw_life_time, index)
	table.remove(self.mine.start_pos, index)
	table.remove(self.mine.target_pos, index)
	table.remove(self.mine.target, index)
	table.remove(self.mine.speed, index)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	role_util.setup_role_action(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- mine state
	self.mine_state = mine_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- mine state machine
	self.mine_machine = simple_state_machine:new(self.mine_state, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.mine_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.mine_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.mine_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.mine_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 역할 액션이 available하고 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(
		self.cs_action, battle_constants.default_search_range
	)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.mine_state:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 이번 프레임의 대상이 업데이트 되지 않도록 mine state를 먼저 돌림
	if self.mine_state then self.mine_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
